definition_zh: 足智多谋的；善于应变的；点子多的；就地取材的；能想办法的
definition_en: good at finding practical ways of dealing with problems, especially by making clever use of whatever is available
core_image: 口袋里没有现成工具，手却在暗处摸到一样东西，随即把它变成钥匙
scene: 停电又下着大雨，一位旅店主人翻出旧罐头和几支蜡烛，硬是让客人们吃上了一顿热饭。When the storm cut the power, the resourceful innkeeper served the guests a hot supper made from old cans and a few candles.
sceneCN: 这里 resourceful 是「点子多的、善于应变」（第 1 个义项：困境里总能造出办法）；句意：暴雨断了电，那位足智多谋的旅店主人用旧罐头和几支蜡烛，给客人们端上了一顿热饭。可想象的细节：黑暗的前台、蜡烛火苗、开罐头的剪刀、桌边裹着外套的客人。

pos.zh: 足智多谋的；善于应变的；点子多的；就地取材的

derivatives.zh: 基础形容词 + -ness 构成性质名词，义为「足智多谋；善于应变」
基础形容词 + -ly 构成副词，义为「机敏地；巧用地」
基础词，指「资源；办法」，-ful 表示「充满」

senses.title: Full of resources: able to create a way out
senses.titleCN: 点子多：困境里总能造出办法
senses.definition: able to find practical ways of dealing with problems, often by making clever use of whatever is available
senses.definitionCN: 善于用手头现有之物想出实用办法来应对问题的
senses.example: The islanders are famously resourceful and repair almost everything by hand.
senses.exampleCN: 这些岛民以点子多著称，几乎什么都能亲手修好。
senses.why: Latin -ful means full of: a resourceful person is full of resources, so the picture of a refilling spring moves inside the mind.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁后缀 -ful 意为「充满」：resourceful 就是「装满了 resource（办法）」的人，泉水不断蓄满的画面于是被搬进了人的头脑。

senses.title: Good at using whatever is at hand
senses.titleCN: 就地取材：手边有什么就用什么
senses.definition: skilled at turning ordinary or limited material into something useful when proper supplies are missing
senses.definitionCN: 在缺少正规物资时，善于把普通或有限的材料变成有用之物的
senses.example: A resourceful teacher turns old newspapers into reading material.
senses.exampleCN: 一位就地取材的老师把旧报纸变成了阅读材料。
senses.why: A spring serves whoever comes to it, whatever container they carry. Likewise a resourceful person draws on whatever is near rather than waiting for the ideal tool.
senses.whyCN: 泉水对带着任何容器来的人都供水；resourceful 的人也一样，就近取用现成的东西，而不是死等最理想的工具。

senses.title: Turning scarcity into opportunity
senses.definition: managing well when money, time or equipment is in short supply, so that a small budget still produces results
senses.definitionCN: 在资金、时间或设备紧缺时仍能妥善安排，用很小的预算做出成果的
senses.example: Their resourceful design team built the whole exhibit on a tiny budget.
senses.exampleCN: 他们那支善于变通的团队用极小的预算做成了整个展览。
senses.why: The word was built on resource, meaning money and materials. When these run low, ingenuity becomes the resource that rises again, and the adjective names whoever finds it.
senses.whyCN: 这个词本就建立在 resource（钱财物资）之上。当这些变少时，机灵成了那口重新涌上来的泉，而这个形容词就用来称呼那个找到它的人。

senses.title: Quick thinking under pressure
senses.titleCN: 临场应变：压力下的急智
senses.definition: responding fast with a clever idea when a problem appears suddenly and there is no time to plan
senses.definitionCN: 问题突然出现、来不及计划时，迅速想出一个巧妙主意的
senses.example: When the power failed, a resourceful nurse found candles in a cupboard and kept the clinic running.
senses.exampleCN: 断电时，一位机敏的护士在柜子里找到蜡烛，让诊所继续运转。
senses.why: Pressure is the moment of greatest need. A resourceful response is the supply rising exactly when it is drawn on, with no time spent looking elsewhere.
senses.whyCN: 压力就是最需要的时刻。resourceful 的应对，正是供给在被取用的那一刻立刻涌起，来不及到别处去找。

senses.title: Applied to people, plans and methods
senses.definition: describing not only a person but also an approach, scheme or method that shows this cleverness
senses.definitionCN: 不仅形容人，也形容体现这种聪明的办法、方案或做法
senses.example: They rescued the expedition with a resourceful plan that used local boats and a borrowed radio.
senses.exampleCN: 他们用一份就地取材的方案，靠本地小船和一台借来的无线电救回了考察队。
senses.why: A plan can carry the spring with it: once a scheme is built on drawing on what is there, the plan itself is called resourceful.
senses.whyCN: 方案也能带着这口泉：一份建立在「就地取用」之上的方案，本身就可以被称为 resourceful。

senses.title: Ingenious rather than rich
senses.definition: in older or formal use, having plenty of money, supplies or means, rather than showing cleverness
senses.definitionCN: 较早或正式用法中，指钱物丰足、手段充裕，而不是强调聪明
senses.example: In the old accounts, a resourceful estate had its own well, mill and granary.
senses.exampleCN: 在旧时的账册里，一座资源充裕的庄园自有水井、磨坊与粮仓。
senses.why: This is the literal sense of full of resources: not clever use of supplies, just plenty of them. The modern clever sense grew from it and largely replaced it.
senses.whyCN: 这是「充满资源」的字面义：不是巧妙利用，而是物资本身很充足。现代「聪明」义由此长出，并在很大程度上取代了它。

senses.title: Ingenuity in speech and argument
senses.definition: skilled at finding words, arguments or ways round an obstacle in a conversation or discussion
senses.definitionCN: 在交谈或讨论中善于找到话语、论据，或绕过障碍的办法的
senses.example: He gave a resourceful reply that answered the question without revealing the price.
senses.exampleCN: 他给了一个机巧的回答，既回应了问题，又没透露价格。
senses.why: Speech is another place where supplies run out. A resourceful speaker makes new words rise on the spot, just as a spring refills.
senses.whyCN: 话语也是资源会耗尽的地方。能言善道的人当场让新的说法涌出来，就像泉眼重新蓄满。

senses.title: In praise: self-reliant and unflappable
senses.definition: used approvingly of someone who stays calm, relies on themselves and keeps finding answers when others give up
senses.definitionCN: 用于赞赏那些在别人放弃时仍保持冷静、靠自己不断找到答案的人
senses.example: Neighbours call her resourceful because she never panics and always finds a way.
senses.exampleCN: 邻居们说她机敏能干，因为她从不慌张，总能找到办法。
senses.why: Repeated experience of supplies rising under need turns into a settled habit. The adjective then praises a steady character, not just a single clever act.
senses.whyCN: 供给在需要时反复升起，久而久之变成稳定的习惯；于是这个形容词赞扬的是一种稳当的性格，而不只是一次聪明的举动。

intro.en: Resourceful is a French formation: an English base word with the French suffix -ful, which comes from Latin plere, to fill. French gave English -ous for this meaning, and -ful was borrowed through words such as powerful and careful.
intro.cn: resourceful 是法语式的构词：英语词基 resource 加上法语来源的后缀 -ful，-ful 出自拉丁语 plere「填满」。表示「充满」时法语本给英语提供的是 -ous，而 -ful 是通过 powerful、careful 一类词进入英语的。

items.en: Pler and plere mean to fill; the related adjective plenus means full and gives English plenty and plentiful.
items.cn: pler、plere 意为「填满」；相关形容词 plenus 意为「满的」，衍生出英语的 plenty、plentiful。

items.en: The adjective suffix is -ful, from Old French -ful and ultimately Latin plenus, meaning full, as in beautiful and careful.
items.cn: 形容词后缀 -ful 源自加勒语系中的法语 -ful，最终出自拉丁 plenus「满的」，如 beautiful、careful。

items.en: Resource first appears in the 1610s meaning a means of getting out of difficulty, borrowed through French from Latin resurgere, to rise again.
items.cn: resource 约在十七世纪十年代出现，意为「摆脱困境的手段」，经由法语借自拉丁 resurgere「再次升起」。

items.en: Resourceful is recorded in the 1660s and first describes a person with plenty of means and supplies before it comes to mean clever and adaptable.
items.cn: resourceful 于十七世纪六十年代见于文献，最初指手段与物资都很充裕的人，后来才指聪明善变通。

items.en: The clever and adaptable sense becomes the dominant one, helped by adventure and colonial writing that praises people who manage with little.
items.cn: 到了十九世纪后期，「聪明善变通」成为主要含义，探险与殖民写作中对「以少成事」之人的赞扬起了推动作用。

items.en: Modern English uses it mainly as a term of praise for practical self-reliance, while the older sense of well supplied survives in very formal writing.
items.cn: 现代英语主要用它赞扬务实、自立的品质；「物资充裕」这一旧义只残存在极正式的文本里。

note.en: The first group gathers words built on the same resource stem; the second groups adjectives that praise cleverness or independence.
note.cn: 第一组是建立在同一 resource 词干上的词族；第二组是赞美聪明或独立的形容词。

entries.definition: a supply of something useful that can be drawn on when needed
entries.definitionCN: resourceful 所依托的名词，指需要时可动用的资源或办法

entries.definition: the quality of finding practical ways out of difficulty
entries.definitionCN: 由 resourceful 加 -ness 构成，指足智多谋这种品质

entries.definition: in a way that shows clever use of whatever is available
entries.definitionCN: 由 resourceful 加 -ly 构成，指机敏地、巧加利用地

entries.definition: very clever and original, especially about ideas or machines
entries.definitionCN: 巧妙的、有独创性的；它更强调想法的巧妙，resourceful 更强调在缺资源时找出路

entries.definition: good at thinking of new ideas and making new things
entries.definitionCN: 有创造力的；重点在做出新东西，而不一定处于窘迫处境

entries.definition: able to change in order to suit new conditions
entries.definitionCN: 适应性强的；侧重随环境调整自己，而不强调主动造出办法

entries.definition: able to do things and make decisions without help
entries.definitionCN: 自力更生的；只强调不求人，不强调整体上的巧思

entries.definition: concerned with real actions and useful results rather than theory
entries.definitionCN: 务实的；只是说明重实效，不含「聪明应变」的褒义色彩

normalIntro.en: Real word formation, real collocations and the true Latin picture behind resource and -ful.
normalIntro.cn: 基于真实构词、真实搭配，以及 resource 与 -ful 背后真实的拉丁语意象。

normal.en: resourceful = resource + -ful, so literally full of resources; whoever is full of resources is full of ways out.
normal.cn: resourceful 即 resource 加 -ful，字面是「装满资源」，装满资源的人自然装满办法。

normal.en: The suffix -ful means full of, as in careful, helpful and powerful, so aim to read the first part as the root.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ful 意为「充满」，如 careful、helpful、powerful；读这个词时先抓前半部分的词根。

normal.en: resource itself comes from Latin re-, again, plus surgere, to rise, so being resourceful means letting supplies rise again when they run low.
normal.cn: resource 本身源于拉丁 re-「再」加 surgere「升起」，所以 resourceful 就是让供给在变少时重新升上来。

normal.en: The noun form is resourcefulness and the adverb form is resourcefully, both keeping the whole adjective before the suffix.
normal.cn: 名词形式是 resourcefulness，副词形式是 resourcefully，都在整个形容词后加后缀。

normal.en: Compare resourceful, ingenious and adaptable: resourceful stresses solving problems with little, ingenious stresses a clever idea, adaptable stresses fitting into change.
normal.cn: 对比 resourceful、ingenious 与 adaptable：resourceful 强调用很少的东西解决问题，ingenious 强调整体构思的巧妙，adaptable 强调适应变化。

abstract.en: Picture a hand closing over one small object in the dark, then using it as the key to a locked door.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手在黑暗里摸到一件小东西，随后把它当作打开那扇锁着门的钥匙。

abstract.en: Picture a table with an empty toolbox, yet the meal still ends up on the plates.
abstract.cn: 想象一张桌子旁摆着空空的工具箱，可最后饭菜照样端上了盘。

abstract.en: Picture a spring on dry land: the wetter the shortage gets, the harder the spring pushes up.
abstract.cn: 想象旱地上的一口泉：越是缺水，泉眼反而涌得越起劲。

examples.en: She is resourceful enough to turn an empty classroom into a science lab.
examples.cn: 她很有办法，能把一间空教室变成科学实验室。

examples.en: The crew had to be resourceful when the engine failed in mid-ocean.
examples.cn: 船在洋中断了引擎，船员们只能靠自己的办法应对。

examples.en: Each spring, resourceful farmers dry the surplus fruit and sell it in town.
examples.cn: 每年春天，点子多的农户把多余的水果晒干，再卖到镇上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞索斯福」——泉水（瑞索斯）里满是福气，怎么舀都舀不完，这样的人点子多、办法多；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 英语 resource（资源；办法，源自拉丁 resurgere：re-「再」加 surgere「升起」）加后缀 -ful（充满，出自拉丁 plenus「满的」），整词字面为「装满了资源」，转指「装满了办法的人」。

sensesIntro.en: All eight senses return to one idea: resources running low and yet something useful rising up. The senses differ in whether the sources are material, mental, verbal or simply a settled habit of self-reliance.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都回到同一个意思：资源将尽，仍有可用的东西升起来。差别只在升起的是物资、心智、话语，还是已经沉淀为习惯的自立。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand finds something usable where others see nothing.
core.cn: 核心意象：在别人看不见东西的地方，一只手摸到了可用的东西。

branches.en: INNER SUPPLY: the mind keeps producing ways out, especially when pressure leaves no time to plan.
branches.cn: 内在供给：头脑不断产出办法，压力大到来不及计划时尤其如此。

branches.en: MATERIAL SUPPLY: whatever is at hand, however ordinary, is treated as enough.
branches.cn: 物质供给：手边哪怕最平常的东西，也被当作足够用。

branches.en: EXTENDED SUPPLY: the quality moves from people to plans, schemes and methods.
branches.cn: 借用的供给：这种品质从人转移到方案、计划和做法上。

branches.en: LITERAL SUPPLY: the old sense simply names plentiful means, without any cleverness.
branches.cn: 字面供给：旧的义项只表示物资充裕，并不含聪明的意思。

branches.en: SPOKEN AND SETTLED SUPPLY: it also covers quick speech and a steady, praised character.
branches.cn: 口头与沉淀的供给：既覆盖临场的巧语，也覆盖受人称赞的稳定性格。

intro.en: Resourceful is base plus suffix: -ful attaches the idea of being full of something, and its products -ness and -ly keep the whole stem before adding their own endings.
intro.cn: resourceful 由词基加后缀构成：-ful 表示「充满某物」，它派生出的 -ness 与 -ly 都保留整个词干再加后缀。

latinIntro.en: The stem in the word is resource, from Latin resurgere, re- plus surgere, and the suffix -ful goes back to Latin plenus, full.
latinIntro.cn: 词中承载意义的词干是 resource，源自拉丁 resurgere（re- 加 surgere）；后缀 -ful 则追溯到拉丁 plenus「满的」。

items.meaning: a supply that can be drawn on
items.meaningCN: 词基：需要时可取用的资源或办法
items.example: Resource is the stem that carries the meaning.
items.exampleCN: resource 是承载核心意义的词干。

items.meaning: full of the quality named by the base
items.meaningCN: 形容词后缀：充满词基所指之物
items.example: The suffix -ful changes a noun into an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ful 把名词变成形容词。

items.meaning: full of resources or of ways out
items.meaningCN: 本词：装满资源，即办法多
items.example: Resourceful keeps both parts visible.
items.exampleCN: resourceful 里两个部分都清晰可见。

items.meaning: the state of being full of resources
items.meaningCN: 名词后缀：把形容词变成性质名词
items.example: The suffix -ness forms resourcefulness.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ness 构成 resourcefulness。

items.example: Resourcefulness is a quality teachers admire.
items.exampleCN: 足智多谋是一种老师欣赏的品质。

items.meaning: in the manner of being resourceful
items.example: The suffix -ly forms resourcefully.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ly 构成 resourcefully。

items.meaningCN: 派生副词：机敏地、巧用地
items.example: She resourcefully rebuilt the fence by hand.
items.exampleCN: 她靠自己动手机敏地修好了围栏。

items.meaningCN: 复合形容词：资源丰富的
items.example: The compound resource-rich describes a country.
items.exampleCN: 复合词 resource-rich 用来形容国家。

items.meaning: given too little money or staff
items.meaningCN: 复合形容词：资源配备不足的
items.example: The compound under-resourced describes schools.
items.exampleCN: 复合词 under-resourced 用来形容学校。

items.meaningCN: 同构词：充满力量，帮助记住 -ful 的含义
items.example: Powerful shows the same suffix pattern.
items.exampleCN: powerful 展示了同样的后缀模式。

latinEntries.example: Resurgere is the source of resource.
latinEntries.exampleCN: resurgere 是 resource 的来源。
plenus 是后缀 -ful 的来源。

definition_zh: 报复；还击；反击；以牙还牙；回敬
definition_en: to do something harmful to someone in return for harm they have done to you
core_image: 一个人被推了一下，立刻转身推回去同样的力道
scene: 两个邻村为水渠争了多年，每次有人放水，对方就会堵一次。Every time one village diverted the stream, the other retaliated by blocking the shared channel the next day.
sceneCN: 这里 retaliate 是「报复、还击」（第 1 个义项：被打后还手）；句意：每当一个村子把溪水引走，另一个村子第二天就会堵住共用的水渠作为报复。可想象的细节：泥筑的水渠、扛着铁锹的村民、被堵住的水口、渠中退去的水。

pos.zh: 报复；还击；以牙还牙
以（某种行为）进行报复（多见于 retaliate with、retaliate by）

collocations.zh: 用做某事的方式来报复

derivatives.zh: 基础动词 + -ion 构成名词，义为「报复；反击」
基础词干 + -ory 构成形容词，义为「报复性的」
基础动词 + -or 构成施动者名词，义为「报复者」，较少使用

senses.title: To hit back after being hurt
senses.definition: to do something harmful to someone because they have harmed you first
senses.definitionCN: 因为对方先伤害了你，便以有害的行动回击对方
senses.example: He never hit anyone first, but he always retaliates if someone strikes him.
senses.exampleCN: 他从不先动手，但只要有人打他，他一定会还手。
senses.why: Latin re- means back and talis means of such a kind, so retaliate is to give back in the same kind, like for like.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁前缀 re- 表示「回」，talis 表示「这样的、同样的」，所以 retaliate 就是「用同样的方式还回去」，以牙还牙。

senses.title: An answer in kind
senses.titleCN: 同样对待：给什么还什么
senses.definition: to answer an act with a similar act, good or bad, though modern use is almost always about harm
senses.definitionCN: 以相似的行为回应对方的行为，好坏都可以，但现代用法几乎只用于伤害性的回击
senses.example: They retaliated with a joke as sharp as the insult.
senses.exampleCN: 他们用一句同样尖刻的玩笑回敬了那句侮辱。
senses.why: The tal- element carries the idea of sameness: the reply is measured to match the first blow, even when that reply is only a sharp word.
senses.whyCN: tal- 这一成分含「相同」的意思：回击是按第一次的力道配好尺寸的，哪怕回击只是一句尖刻的话。

senses.title: Military strike for a strike
senses.definition: when a country or armed group attacks an enemy in answer to an attack it has suffered
senses.definitionCN: 国家或武装团体在遭到攻击后，反过来攻击敌人
senses.example: The government vowed to retaliate after its border posts were shelled.
senses.exampleCN: 边境哨所遭炮击后，政府誓言进行反击。
senses.why: War is where the matching of blows is counted most exactly: one strike is answered by one strike, so the military sense keeps the oldest shape of the word.
senses.whyCN: 战争里「还手」的计算最精确：挨一击就还一击，因此军事义保留了这个词最古老的样子。

senses.title: Trade reprisal: tariffs and sanctions
senses.definition: to impose higher tariffs, import bans or other trade measures in response to measures taken by another country
senses.definitionCN: 为回应另一国采取的贸易措施，而加征关税、禁止进口或采取其他贸易手段
senses.example: One side raised duties, and the other retaliated on steel and cars.
senses.exampleCN: 一方提高了关税，另一方就对钢材和汽车实施了报复。
senses.why: The same give and take that works between people is applied to countries: a duty is met by a duty, so harm is matched instead of blood.
senses.whyCN: 人与人之间的「你来我往」被搬到国家之间：你加税我也加税，还回去的是同样的伤害，而不是拳头。

senses.title: Retaliation without a person
senses.definition: used of a virus, a market, a machine or a force that strikes back at whoever provoked it
senses.definitionCN: 用于病毒、市场、机器或某种力量，对挑动它的人加以回击
senses.example: The infection retaliated by returning even stronger after the first drug failed.
senses.exampleCN: 第一种药失效后，感染以更强的形式卷土重来。
senses.why: The verb needs only two things, an injury and a matching reply. The agent can be anything that returns what it received, from tissue to trade.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词只需要两样东西：一次伤害和一次相配的回击。施动者可以是任何「你给什么它就还什么」的东西，从身体组织到贸易。

senses.title: Retaliate against a rule or an order
senses.titleCN: 对规定或命令的对抗性回击
senses.definition: to act against a rule, employer or authority that has restricted you, often in a way that feels like payback
senses.definitionCN: 对限制自己的规定、雇主或权威采取对抗行动，常常带着还以颜色的意味
senses.example: Workers retaliated against the new rota by refusing to cover extra shifts.
senses.exampleCN: 工人们以拒绝顶班的方式回击新的排班表。
senses.why: A restriction can feel like a blow. Retaliating against a rule means answering the rule, not the person who wrote it.
senses.whyCN: 一条限制也能像一记打击。对规定进行报复，就是回敬那条规定本身，而不是写规定的人。

senses.title: In politics and debate: hitting back
senses.definition: to answer criticism or an attack on your reputation with a counter-attack of your own
senses.definitionCN: 面对对自己的批评或名誉攻击，反之以反击
senses.example: The minister retaliated by releasing letters that embarrassed the opposition.
senses.exampleCN: 部长公布了一些让反对派难堪的信件，作为回击。
senses.why: In argument, the first blow is an accusation and the reply is a counter-accusation. The shape is still talis: the answer is of the same kind.
senses.whyCN: 在论辩中，第一击是指控，回击就是反指控。形状仍是 talis：还回去的东西性质相同。

senses.title: Retaliation that costs the retaler
senses.definition: used in warnings about how retaliating tends to make the conflict grow and end up hurting the side that strikes back
senses.definitionCN: 用于警告：报复往往会让冲突升级，最终也伤到还手的一方
senses.example: Experts warn that if both sides retaliate, the farmers will be the ones who lose.
senses.exampleCN: 专家警告说，如果双方都报复，吃亏的会是农户。
senses.why: Each return invites another return. Once the word is used in warnings, it carries the knowledge that giving back in the same kind can start a loop.
senses.whyCN: 每一次还手都会招来下一次还手。当这个词被用来警告时，它就带上了这样的认识：以牙还牙可能引发循环。

intro.en: Retaliate is Latin-shaped: legal Latin retaliare, to make return in kind, was built on re-, back, and talis, of such a kind. Later Latin used the past participle retaliatus, and English took up the verb in the 1600s.
intro.cn: retaliate 是拉丁语形态的词：法律拉丁语 retaliare（以同样方式回报）由 re-「回」和 talis「这样的」构成；后世拉丁语使用过去分词 retaliatus，英语在十七世纪吸收了动词形式。

items.en: Talis means of such a kind or such a sort; it also gives the legal phrase in kind, matching one thing with another of the same sort.
items.cn: talis 意为「这样的、同类的」；它也是「以同样之物回报」这类法律表述的来源，意思是拿同类的东西相抵。

items.en: Re- adds the meaning back. Retaliare is used in legal language for returning like for like, often in the phrase to give tit for tat.
items.cn: re- 加上「回」的意思。retaliare 用于法律语言，指以同样的方式回报，常等于「一报还一报」。

items.en: The past participle retaliatus, having returned in kind, is the form recorded in later Latin sources before the verb passes into English.
items.cn: 过去分词 retaliatus（已经以同等方式回报）是后世拉丁文献中记录的形式，动词随后传入英语。

items.en: The English verb retaliate is first recorded in the early 1600s, at first in the neutral sense of repaying or returning a favour as well as a harm.
items.cn: 英语动词 retaliate 最早记录于十七世纪十年代，起初是中性的，既可指回报恩惠，也可指回敬伤害。

items.en: The neutral sense fades and retaliate settles on the return of injury, strengthened by military and diplomatic writing that uses it for answering a strike.
items.cn: 中性义逐渐消失，retaliate 固定用于回敬伤害；军事与外交文本中「回敬打击」的用法进一步巩固了这一含义。

items.en: Modern English extends the verb to trade tariffs, sanctions, reputation and even infection, while keeping the strict idea of a matching return.
items.cn: 现代英语把该动词扩展到贸易关税、制裁、名誉乃至感染，但始终保留「相配的回报」这一核心意思。

note.en: The first group gathers true family members and one dangerous spelling neighbour; the second compares verbs for answering an injury.
note.cn: 第一组是真正的同族词，外加一个容易混淆的形近词；第二组是比较各种「回应伤害」的动词。

entries.definition: the act of hitting back after being harmed
entries.definitionCN: 由 retaliate 加 -ion 构成的名词，指报复、反击这一行为

entries.definition: done as an answer to a harm or attack
entries.definitionCN: retaliate 加 -ory 构成的形容词，指报复性的

entries.definition: to allow what you dislike without opposing it. It looks close to retaliate but comes from Latin tolerare, to bear, a different root.
entries.definitionCN: 容忍不喜欢的事而不反抗。它拼写相近，却来自拉丁 tolerare「承受」，词源不同。

entries.definition: to punish someone for a wrong done to someone else
entries.definitionCN: 为他人所受之害去惩罚某人；retaliate 多指为自己受到的伤害当场还回

entries.definition: to harm someone because they harmed you, often with a personal, emotional motive
entries.definitionCN: 出于个人情绪去伤害伤害过自己的人；情感色彩更重

entries.definition: to attack an enemy that has just attacked you
entries.definitionCN: 对刚进攻自己的敌人发起反击；多用于军事

entries.definition: to give money back, or to return something in kind
entries.definitionCN: 偿还；回报。中性词，可用于还钱、报恩，也可用于报复

entries.definition: a violent or hostile act taken in return for an injury
entries.definitionCN: 报复行为；多指国家或组织层面的以行动回击的报复

normalIntro.en: Real parts of the word, real collocations and the true legal Latin behind it.
normalIntro.cn: 基于真实的构词成分、真实搭配，以及它背后真实的法律拉丁语来源。

normal.en: re- means back and the tal- part means of such a kind, so retaliate is give back the same kind.
normal.cn: re- 表示「回」，tal- 表示「同样的」，所以 retaliate 就是「还回同样的东西」。

normal.en: Inside the word the tal- part echoes Latin talis, of such a kind: the reply must be of the same sort as the blow, which is the whole point of retaliation.
normal.cn: 词中的 tal- 呼应拉丁语 talis「同样的」：还回去的东西必须与挨的那一下同类，这正是报复的要害。

normal.en: The family is retaliate, retaliation and retaliatory: verb, noun and adjective on one stem.
normal.cn: 词族是 retaliate、retaliation、retaliatory：动词、名词、形容词共用一个词干。

normal.en: The usual pattern is retaliate against someone for something, with a person or country as the object of against.
normal.cn: 常见句型是 retaliate against someone for something，against 后面接人或国家。

normal.en: Compare retaliate and retaliate in kind: the phrase in kind spells out the talis idea of paying back with the same item.
normal.cn: 对比 retaliate 与 retaliate in kind：in kind 这个短语把 talis「同类相抵」的意思说透了。

abstract.en: Picture a hand pushing, and another hand pushing back with exactly matched force.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手推过来，另一只手用刚好相同的力气推回去。

abstract.en: Picture a reflector sending the same shape of light straight back to the lamp.
abstract.cn: 想象一面反射镜把同样形状的光原样送回到灯上。

abstract.en: Picture a ripple that returns to the bank exactly where it started.
abstract.cn: 想象一道波纹，绕一圈后正好回到它起浪的那道岸。

examples.en: If someone insults her, she retaliates immediately.
examples.cn: 要是有人侮辱她，她马上就会还击。

examples.en: The company retaliated against the union by cutting overtime.
examples.cn: 公司削减加班时间，作为对工会的报复。

examples.en: Both sides fear that retaliating will only make the dispute worse.
examples.cn: 双方都担心报复只会让争执变得更糟。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞泰里 A 他」——对方先推了你，你就转向「他」，把他推回原来的位置，一报还一报；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁 re-（回；再）加 talis（这样的；同样的），构成法律拉丁语 retaliare（以同样方式回报），再入英语为 retaliate，核心义「用同样的方式还回去」。

sensesIntro.en: Retaliate always contains two events linked by sameness: first an injury, then a reply of the same kind. The senses differ only in what gets returned and who returns it, from fists to tariffs.
sensesIntro.cn: retaliate 里永远有两个由「相同」连起来的事件：先有伤害，再有同类的回击。各义项的差别只在于还回去的是什么、由谁还回去，从拳头到关税。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a push returned with the same force.
core.cn: 核心意象：被推一下，就用同样的力气推回去。

branches.en: PERSONAL RETURN: a blow or a word is answered in kind, measure for measure.
branches.cn: 个人层面的回击：一击或一句被原样回敬，一报还一报。

branches.en: MILITARY RETURN: a strike is answered by a strike, the most exact form of matching.
branches.cn: 军事回击：以打击回应打击，是「配平」最精确的形式。

branches.en: ECONOMIC RETURN: duties, bans and sanctions are traded in place of blows.
branches.cn: 经济回击：用关税、禁令与制裁替代拳头来往来。

branches.en: UNPERSONAL RETURN: even a virus or a rule can be said to hit back at whoever provoked it.
branches.cn: 非人格的回击：连病毒或规定都可以回击挑动它的一方。

branches.en: PUBLIC AND COSTLY RETURN: reputations are attacked in return, and the warning is that the loop hurts both sides.
branches.cn: 公开且代价高昂的回击：以攻击名誉回敬，同时也提醒这种循环最终两败俱伤。

intro.en: Retaliate takes three suffixes: -ate makes the Latin verb, -ion makes the noun and -ory and -or build the adjective and agent noun. The re- and tal- at the front belong to the Latin source.
intro.cn: retaliate 前后用到三种后缀：-ate 构成拉丁式动词，-ion 构成名词，-ory 与 -or 构成形容词和施动者名词；开头的 re- 与 tal- 属于拉丁语来源。

latinIntro.en: The Latin source is retaliare, built on re- back and talis of such a kind, and its participle retaliatus carries the meaning into English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语来源是 retaliare，由 re-「回」和 talis「这样的」构成；它的分词 retaliatus 把这一意思带进英语。

items.example: The prefix re- moves the action back to the first doer.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 让动作回到最初做这件事的人身上。

items.example: Retaliate is the core verb of the family.
items.exampleCN: retaliate 是这个词族的核心动词。

items.meaningCN: 后缀：构成拉丁来源的动词
items.example: The suffix -ate marks the verb form.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ate 标出动词形式。

items.meaningCN: 名词后缀：报复这一行为
items.example: The suffix -ion forms retaliation.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ion 构成 retaliation。

items.example: Retaliation followed the raid.
items.exampleCN: 袭击之后就是报复。

items.meaning: serving as a return of harm
items.example: The suffix -ory forms retaliatory.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ory 构成 retaliatory。

items.example: Retaliatory duties were announced.
items.exampleCN: 报复性关税被宣布了。

items.meaning: a person who does the action
items.example: The suffix -or forms retaliator.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -or 构成 retaliator。

items.example: Tit for tat names the same matching idea.
items.exampleCN: 以牙还牙这一说法体现了同样的「配平」思路。

items.example: Tolerate is a look-alike with a different root.
items.exampleCN: tolerate 是词源不同的形近词。

latinEntries.structure: Latin adjective, of such a kind
latinEntries.meaningCN: 拉丁形容词：这样的、同类
拉丁动词：以同样方式回报
拉丁过去分词：已以同样方式回报
latinEntries.example: Retaliatus links the Latin verb to English.
latinEntries.exampleCN: retaliatus 把拉丁动词与英语连接起来。

definition_zh: 视网膜；眼球后壁的感光层；（喻）承接映象之网
definition_en: the thin light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye that carries images to the brain, or something that plays that part
core_image: 眼球后壁一张细密的网，光点落在网眼上，被一粒粒接住
scene: 医生指着扫描图上一处细小的裂口，对患者说这层膜一旦从后壁剥落，视野边缘就会像拉上幕布。The doctor pointed to a tiny tear in the scan and warned that if the retina peels away from the back wall, a curtain will slide across the side of the vision.
sceneCN: 这里 retina 是「视网膜」（第 1 个义项：眼球后壁的感光层）；句意：医生指着扫描图上一处细小的裂口，警告说如果这层膜从后壁剥落，视野一侧就会像拉上幕布一样变黑。可想象的细节：亮着的扫描仪屏幕、放大的眼球后壁图、医生手中的指示笔、患者紧张的眼神。

pos.zh: 视网膜；眼球后壁的感光层

derivatives.zh: 基础词 + -al 构成形容词，义为「视网膜的」
retino- + -pathy（病变）构成名词，义为「视网膜病变」
retino- + -blast（始基细胞）+ -oma（肿瘤）构成名词，义为「视网膜母细胞瘤」
retin- + -itis（炎症）构成名词，义为「视网膜炎」

senses.title: The light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye
senses.definition: the thin layer of cells lining the inside back of the eye that turns light into signals for the brain
senses.definitionCN: 衬在眼球内壁后方的薄层细胞，把光变成传给大脑的信号
senses.example: Light falls through the pupil and lands on the retina at the back of the eye.
senses.exampleCN: 光穿过瞳孔，落在眼球后壁的视网膜上。
senses.why: Latin rete means net and -ina means made of, so the retina is literally the net-like tissue, named for its fine web of nerve cells.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 rete 意为「网」，-ina 表示「由……构成」，所以 retina 字面就是「网状的组织」，得名于它细密的神经细胞网络。

senses.title: Where the image forms
senses.definition: the screen at the back of the eyeball on which the lens throws a focused image of the outside world
senses.definitionCN: 眼球后部的一层屏，晶状体把外界景物聚焦成像投在上面
senses.example: In a normal eye, the image forms neatly on the retina.
senses.exampleCN: 正常眼睛所成的像会清晰地落在视网膜上。
senses.why: The lens has to place its focus on the net. Naming the net as the image plane is the next step after naming the tissue.
senses.whyCN: 晶状体必须把焦点放在这张网上。把这张网说成像面，就是在「组织」之外的下一步说法。

senses.title: Photoreceptors: rods and cones
senses.definition: the layer holding the rods that register light and dark and the cones that register colour
senses.definitionCN: 含视杆细胞与视锥细胞的层，前者感知明暗，后者感知颜色
senses.example: The central part of the retina is packed with cones and sees colour best.
senses.exampleCN: 视网膜中央部分布满视锥细胞，分辨颜色的能力最强。
senses.why: A net only matters through its knots. Here the knots are photoreceptors, so the word also names the cell layer that does the actual sensing.
senses.whyCN: 网的价值在于网结。这里的网结就是感光细胞，因此这个词也指真正完成感光任务的细胞层。

senses.title: The retina in medicine: detachment and disease
senses.definition: used in medicine for the structure that can tear, detach or be damaged by disease such as retinopathy
senses.definitionCN: 医学上指可能撕裂、脱离，或受视网膜病变等疾病损伤的结构
senses.example: A sudden flash of light can be a sign that the retina is tearing.
senses.exampleCN: 突然出现闪光，可能是视网膜撕裂的信号。
senses.why: Because the retina is a distinct membrane, it can come off the wall like lining peeled from a box, which gives doctors a precise thing to name and treat.
senses.whyCN: 因为视网膜是一层独立的膜，它可以像从盒壁上揭下的衬纸一样脱落，这使医生有了可精确命名的对象去治疗。

senses.title: Retinal imaging
senses.definition: used for photographs and scans of the retina, which show blood vessels and can reveal illness elsewhere in the body
senses.definitionCN: 用于对视网膜的拍照与扫描，能显示血管，并提示身体其他部位的疾病
senses.example: The doctor studied the retina scan and then checked the patient for diabetes.
senses.exampleCN: 医生看了视网膜扫描图，随后给病人做了糖尿病检查。
senses.why: The retina is the only place where blood vessels are seen directly, so naming it gives doctors an inspection window into the whole body.
senses.whyCN: 视网膜是全身唯一能直接看到血管的地方，所以叫它这个名字，就等于给医生开了一扇观察全身的窗。

senses.title: Colour vision and sensitivity
senses.definition: the part spoken of when describing how many colours can be told apart or how well the eye copes with faint light
senses.definitionCN: 谈到能分辨多少颜色、或眼睛在弱光下有多敏锐时所指的那部分
senses.example: Some people have a very sensitive retina and see well by starlight.
senses.exampleCN: 有些人视网膜非常敏感，在星光下也能看得很清楚。
senses.why: Different nets catch different things. The retina sets the limits of what the eye can see, so it is also the word for those limits.
senses.whyCN: 不同的网捞到的东西不同。视网膜决定眼睛能看到什么，于是它也就成了描述这些界限的词。

senses.title: Image sensor in a camera
senses.definition: in popular science and in technology writing, a chip or sensor at the back of a camera that plays the part of the retina
senses.definitionCN: 在科普与技术文章中，指照相机后部充当视网膜角色的芯片或传感器
senses.example: Engineers describe the new sensor as the camera retina that catches every pixel of light.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师把新的传感器称作相机的视网膜，它捕捉到每一像素的光。
senses.why: A camera copies the eye: a lens in front and a sensing surface behind. The surface inherits the name of the net it replaces.
senses.whyCN: 照相机模仿眼睛：前面一片透镜，后面一块感光面。这块感光面就继承了它所替代的那张网的名字。

senses.title: A figurative net of perception
senses.definition: used in literary writing for whatever catches impressions, such as memory, attention or a city attentive to every signal
senses.definitionCN: 文学写作中指承载映象之物，如记忆、注意力，或对一切信号十分警觉的城市
senses.example: Memory is the retina of the mind, and each hour its picture is redrawn.
senses.exampleCN: 记忆是心灵的视网膜，每一小时它上面的画面都会被重新描绘。
senses.why: Once the word means a net that catches light, it can catch any kind of light. The figurative sense keeps the mesh and changes what falls on it.
senses.whyCN: 既然这个词指一张接住光的网，它就能接住任何种类的光。比喻义保留网眼，只换掉落在网上的东西。

intro.en: Retina is a medieval Latin term of anatomy meaning a net or small net. English anatomists adopted it in the 1400s. The older view that the word goes back to Greek rhētinē, a word of uncertain meaning, is now generally doubted.
intro.cn: retina 是中世纪拉丁语的解剖术语，意为「网、小网」，英语解剖学家在十五世纪采用。认为它可追溯到希腊语 rhētinē（含义不明）的旧说，如今一般受到质疑。

items.en: Rete means a net, a mesh or a network; the diminutive reticulum, a small net, gives English reticule and the adjective reticulate.
items.cn: rete 意为网、网眼或网络；指小形式 reticulum（小网）衍生出英语的 reticule 与形容词 reticulate。

items.en: Medical Latin retine or retina means a net; the -ina ending marks something belonging to or made of the net.
items.cn: 医学拉丁语的 retine 或 retina 意为「网」；-ina 结尾表示属于这张网或由它构成。

items.en: The word enters English anatomical writing in the 1400s, describing the fine web of tissue seen inside the back of the eye.
items.cn: 该词在十五世纪进入英语解剖学文献，用来描述眼球内侧后壁所见细密的网状组织。

items.en: Anatomists gradually tie the term to the modern structure as dissection becomes more exact, and the retina is studied as its own layer.
items.cn: 随着解剖日益精确，解剖学家逐渐把这个词固定在现代所指的结构上，视网膜开始被当作独立的一层来研究。

items.en: Rods and cones are described in the 1800s, and the retina becomes the foundation of ophthalmology, of colour-vision study and of early photography.
items.cn: 十九世纪描述了视杆与视锥细胞，视网膜成为眼科学、色觉研究与早期摄影的基础。

items.en: Modern English keeps the anatomical core and adds imaging, computational sensors and figurative uses for anything that catches impressions.
items.cn: 现代英语保留了它作为解剖结构的核心义，并增加影像检查、计算传感器，以及「承接映象之物」的比喻用法。

note.en: The first group gathers true relatives and dangerous look-alikes; the second places the retina among the parts of the eye and words for seeing.
note.cn: 第一组是真正的同族词与容易混淆的形近词；第二组把视网膜放进眼睛的各个部分与「看见」相关的词里。

entries.definition: relating to the retina
entries.definitionCN: retina 加 -al 构成的形容词，指视网膜的

entries.definition: a small net, from Latin rete, net; it shares the same net original with retina
entries.definitionCN: 小网，来自拉丁 rete「网」，与 retina 同源

entries.definition: a group of people who follow an important person. It looks like retina but comes from Latin retinere, to hold back, a different root.
entries.definitionCN: 随从。它形近，却来自拉丁 retinere「留住」，词源不同，只是拼写相近

entries.definition: a form of vitamin A that was first found in the retina. It borrows the retina stem alone, and the suffix -ol marks a chemical.
entries.definitionCN: 维生素 A 的一种形式。名称只有「视网膜」这一部分与目标词相通，-ol 后缀表示化学物质

entries.definition: disease of the retina, often caused by diabetes
entries.definitionCN: 视网膜的病变，常由糖尿病引起

entries.definition: the clear front layer of the eye that light passes through first
entries.definitionCN: 角膜：光线最先穿过的眼球前部透明层

entries.definition: the blood-rich layer that lies just behind the retina
entries.definitionCN: 脉络膜：紧贴视网膜之后的血管丰富层

entries.definition: the small central pit in the retina where sight is sharpest
entries.definitionCN: 中央凹：视网膜中心的小凹陷，视觉最清晰处

entries.definition: the study of light and its behaviour, closely linked to how the eye forms images
entries.definitionCN: 光学：研究光及其行为，与眼睛成像密切相关

normalIntro.en: Real Latin parts, real medical compounds and the actual collocations of the word.
normalIntro.cn: 基于真实的拉丁语成分、真实的医学复合词，以及这个词的实际搭配。

normal.en: The word begins like rete, net in Latin: the retina is the net at the back of the eye.
normal.cn: 这个词开头像拉丁 rete「网」：retina 就是眼球后壁的那张网。

normal.en: The same net root appears in reticulum, small net, and in the adjective reticulate, net-like.
normal.cn: 同样的「网」词根见于 reticulum（小网）和形容词 reticulate（网状的）。

normal.en: Medical compounds use retino- first: retinopathy for disease and retinoblastoma for a tumour of the retina.
normal.cn: 医学复合词以 retino- 开头：retinopathy 指病变，retinoblastoma 指视网膜母细胞瘤。

normal.en: The adjective is retinal and the standard plural is retinas, with retinae as a technical variant.
normal.cn: 形容词是 retinal，常用复数是 retinas，医学变体是 retinae。

normal.en: Compare retina and cornea: the cornea is the clear window at the front, the retina is the sensing net at the back.
normal.cn: 对比 retina 与 cornea：cornea 是眼球前部透明的窗，retina 是后部感光的网。

abstract.en: Picture a fine fishing net spread across the inside back of a dark room, with tiny bright specks settling on it.
abstract.cn: 想象一张细密的渔网铺在暗室的后壁上，细小的光点纷纷落在网上。

abstract.en: Picture a camera with the lens in front and a flat sensor behind, a machine mirror of the eye.
abstract.cn: 想象一架前面有镜头、后面有平整传感器的相机，是眼睛的机械映照。

abstract.en: Picture a curtain sliding from the edge of a theatre stage, as a detached retina is often described.
abstract.cn: 想象剧场舞台一侧拉过来一道幕布，这正是视网膜脱离常被比喻的样子。

examples.en: The retina converts light into nerve signals that the brain can read.
examples.cn: 视网膜把光转化为大脑能读取的神经信号。

examples.en: Damage to the retina can be seen in a simple eye examination.
examples.cn: 视网膜的损伤在简单的眼科检查中就能看出来。

examples.en: Cone cells in the retina let us tell red from green.
examples.cn: 视网膜中的视锥细胞让我们能分辨红与绿。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞提娜」——瑞提娜把一张小网挂在眼球后壁上，专门接住飞来的光点；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 中世纪拉丁语 retina，来自拉丁 rete（网），意为「小网」；-ina 表示属于或由之构成，整词字面为「网状的膜」。旧说有希腊语来源，现今一般认为不可靠。

sensesIntro.en: Every sense of retina stands on one picture: a net that catches light. The senses differ in whether the emphasis is the anatomy, the imaging surface, the medical object, the sensor in a camera, or the artistic net.
sensesIntro.cn: retina 的每个义项都站在同一个画面上：一张接住光的网。差别只在重点是解剖结构、成像面、医学对象、相机传感器，还是文学中的比喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fine net at the back of the eye catches points of light.
core.cn: 核心意象：眼球后壁一张细网，一粒粒接住光点。

branches.en: ANATOMY AND IMAGE: the tissue is described first as a layer, then as the screen where vision is focused.
branches.cn: 解剖与成像：先描述这层组织，再把它说成视觉聚焦的屏幕。

branches.en: SENSING LIMITS: rods, cones, colour and dim light are all properties of the net itself.
branches.cn: 感光限度：视杆、视锥、颜色与弱光，都是这张网自身的属性。

branches.en: MEDICAL OBJECT: a membrane that can tear and a surface that can be scanned, so it becomes a clinic word.
branches.cn: 医学对象：可以撕裂的膜、可以扫描的面，于是它成为临床用词。

branches.en: MACHINE MIRROR: a camera sensor repeats the anatomy of eye plus sensing back wall.
branches.cn: 机器映照：相机传感器重复了「晶状体加后壁感光面」的结构。

branches.en: FIGURATIVE NET: whatever shapes or holds impressions can be called a retina.
branches.cn: 比喻之网：任何塑造或承载映象的东西都可以被称作 retina。

intro.en: Retina is built from a Latin base with a Latin noun ending, and it then works as a prefix and a stem in English medicine: retinal, retinitis, retinopathy, retinoblastoma.
intro.cn: retina 由拉丁词基加拉丁名词词尾构成，随后在英语医学词汇里充当词根与词缀：retinal、retinitis、retinopathy、retinoblastoma。

latinIntro.en: The Latin family is small but firm: rete, a net, with reticulum, a small net, and the adjective reticularis, net-like.
latinIntro.cn: 这一拉丁词族虽小却稳定：rete「网」，加 -iculum 成 reticulum「小网」，加 -aris 成形容词 reticularis「网状的」。

items.example: Retin- is the stem used before suffixes.
items.exampleCN: retin- 是加后缀前使用的词干。

items.meaningCN: 名词词尾：拉丁阴性名词
items.example: The noun ending -a makes the word look like a Latin form.
items.exampleCN: 名词词尾 -a 让这个词看起来像拉丁词形。

items.meaning: the netlike membrane of the eye
items.example: Retina is the base of the medical family.
items.exampleCN: retina 是医学词族的词基。

items.example: The suffix -al forms retinal.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -al 构成 retinal。

items.example: Retinal blood vessels can be photographed.
items.exampleCN: 视网膜血管可以拍成照片。

items.example: The suffix -itis forms retinitis.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -itis 构成 retinitis。

items.example: Retinitis must be treated quickly.
items.exampleCN: 视网膜炎必须尽快治疗。

items.example: The suffix -pathy forms retinopathy.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -pathy 构成 retinopathy。

items.example: Retinopathy is a risk for diabetic patients.
items.exampleCN: 视网膜病变是糖尿病患者的风险。

items.example: The suffix -oma combines with a stem to name a growth.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -oma 与词干组合表示肿瘤。

items.example: Rete is the net behind the name.
items.exampleCN: rete 就是这个名字背后的「网」。

latinEntries.example: Rete is the base of the name.
latinEntries.exampleCN: rete 是这个名字的词基。

latinEntries.example: Reticulum shows the same net root.
latinEntries.exampleCN: reticulum 展示同样的「网」词根。
reticularis 形容任何网状的形态。

definition_zh: 反驳；回敬；反驳性的回答；曲颈瓶；蒸馏罐
definition_en: to answer someone quickly and sharply, usually because their remark has annoyed or challenged you
core_image: 一句话被扔过来，立刻又拧着原路弹回去
scene: 辩论刚结束，那位部长还在走廊里气鼓鼓地说个不停，隔天就写文章回敬批评他的人。 The minister, still bristling after the debate, wrote a sharp article to retort to his critics the next day.
sceneCN: 这里 retort 是「回敬、反击」（第 1 个义项：用尖锐的话当面顶回对方）；句意：部长在辩论后仍怒气未消，隔天写了一篇尖刻文章回敬批评者。

pos.zh: 反驳；回敬；反击
反驳的话；回敬
曲颈瓶；蒸馏罐

derivatives.zh: 喜欢反驳的；反唇相讥的，由 retort 加形容词词尾 -ive 构成
反驳；报复性的回敬，由 retort 加名词词尾 -ion 构成，书面色彩较重
被反驳回敬的；亦作动词过去式，强调回答带刺的口气

senses.title: To snap back an answer
senses.definition: to reply at once and with an edge, usually feeling the other person has challenged or slighted you
senses.definitionCN: 感到对方挑战或冒犯时，立刻带着锋芒地回话
senses.example: She retorted that the plan had never been tested.
senses.exampleCN: 她立刻回敬说，那个方案从未经过检验。
senses.why: The Latin verb retorquere means to twist back, so a retort is an answer twisted back at the speaker.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 retorquere 意为「扭回去」，所以反驳就是把话原路拧回说话人脸上。

senses.title: A sharp answer in words
senses.definition: a short, angry or witty answer given as a return to criticism
senses.definitionCN: 对批评作出的简短、恼怒或机智的回答
senses.example: Her retort made the whole room laugh.
senses.exampleCN: 她的一句回敬让全场都笑了。
senses.why: The action and the utterance share one shape: the noun names the sentence that came snapping back.
senses.whyCN: 动作和话语同形，名词指的就是那句被弹回去的话。

senses.title: The chemistry vessel
senses.definition: a glass or metal vessel with a long neck bent sideways, used for distilling or heating chemicals
senses.definitionCN: 带一根向侧面弯折的长颈的玻璃或金属容器，用于蒸馏或加热化学品
senses.example: The old retort stood on the shelf beside the scales.
senses.exampleCN: 那只旧曲颈瓶摆在架子上、天平旁边。
senses.why: The same twisting image returns: the flask has a neck that turns back on itself, and it carries the answer back.
senses.whyCN: 同一个「扭弯」之意又出现了：这种瓶子的长颈朝向自身弯曲，把蒸出的东西送回。

senses.title: To turn a charge back
senses.definition: to reply to an accusation by accusing the accuser of the same thing
senses.definitionCN: 面对指控时，用同样的指控弹回指控者身上
senses.example: Asked about delays, the manager retorted that the contractors were late.
senses.exampleCN: 被问到延误问题时，经理回敬说承包商才拖沓。
senses.why: If the answer is a twist backwards, then an accusation can be twisted back to its source.
senses.whyCN: 如果回答是反扭回去，那么一项指控也可以扭回它的源头。

senses.title: Returning like for like
senses.definition: used in formal or legal writing for returning an act, insult or injury in the same kind
senses.definitionCN: 在正式或法律文体中表示用同样的一手、同样的话或同样的伤害回敬
senses.example: The court warned that retorted violence only renews the cycle.
senses.exampleCN: 法院警告说，以暴力回敬暴力只会让循环继续。
senses.why: The rebound image widens from words to deeds, and the same exchange turns formal.
senses.whyCN: 「弹回」的画面从语言扩展到行为，这种对等回敬的用法也就变得正式。

senses.title: The industrial retort
senses.definition: a sealed vessel used in industry for heating coal, ore or biomass to drive off gas or liquid
senses.definitionCN: 工业上用来加热煤、矿石或生物质以逼出气体或液体的密闭容器
senses.example: Coal is heated in a retort to produce gas and coke.
senses.exampleCN: 煤在蒸馏罐中被加热，以生产煤气和焦炭。
senses.why: The laboratory flask grew into a factory-scale vessel, but the bent neck and heating idea stay the same.
senses.whyCN: 实验室的小瓶放大成工厂设备，但「弯颈加热」的意象没变。

intro.en: Retort comes from Latin retorquere, to twist back, through French; the flask sense appeared later because the vessel shape twists a neck back on itself.
intro.cn: retort 经法语来自拉丁语 retorquere「扭回去」；瓶子的义项后起，因为器皿的长颈朝自身弯曲。

items.en: Retorquere is re- back plus torquere to twist.
items.cn: retorquere 由 re-（向后）与 torquere（扭）构成。

items.en: Retorta names a broad bowl in medieval Latin.
items.cn: 中古拉丁语 retorta 指一种浅宽碗状器皿。

items.en: Retorte carries the vessel name into French.
items.cn: retorte 把这种器皿之名带入法语。

items.en: Retort first names a flask with a bent neck.
items.cn: 英语 retort 最初指带弯颈的蒸馏瓶。

items.en: The verb meaning to answer sharply grows from the twist image.
items.cn: 「尖锐回敬」的动词义由此生长出来。

items.en: Chemistry keeps the vessel, and ordinary speech keeps the comeback.
items.cn: 现代英语中，化学保留器皿义，日常口语保留回敬义。

note.en: Retort shares its twist with the torquere family and sits close to words for quick, pointed replies.
note.cn: retort 与 torquere 词族共享「扭」的意象，语义上靠近各种快速、带刺的回答。

entries.definition: to move back from a place or position
entries.definitionCN: 撤退：只是拼写相近，词源不同，本身并无「扭」的意思。

entries.definition: great physical pain or the act of causing it
entries.definitionCN: 折磨；酷刑，源自同一个 torquere「扭」。

entries.definition: to pull something out of its natural shape
entries.definitionCN: 扭曲；歪曲，与 retort 同源，前缀不同。

entries.definition: an act of turning back or retaliating in words
entries.definitionCN: 反驳；回敬的行为，由 retort 派生。

entries.definition: to turn around a central point
entries.definitionCN: 旋转：来自旋转之轮的词根，只是与 torquere 字形相近，词源不同。

entries.definition: a reply, especially one made to an answer
entries.definitionCN: 答辩；回话，比 retort 更正式，锋芒较弱。

entries.definition: a quick, clever reply
entries.definitionCN: 妙语回击，借自击剑的「回刺」，偏机智而非愤怒。

entries.definition: a quick answer that replies to a comment
entries.definitionCN: 回敬的话，口语色彩最重。

normalIntro.en: Retort is a reply that is twisted back on its speaker, and the same twist names a flask with a bent neck.
normalIntro.cn: retort 是「反扭回去」的回答，同一个「扭」也命名了那种弯颈的蒸馏瓶。

normal.en: The re- prefix says back, and the torqu- part says twist.
normal.cn: 前缀 re- 表示「往回」，torqu- 表示「扭」，合起来就是顶回去。

normal.en: The torquere family includes distort, torture and torsion.
normal.cn: torquere 词族还包括 distort、torture、torsion。

normal.en: A retort is shorter and sharper than a reply.
normal.cn: retort 比普通的 reply 更短、更带刺。

normal.en: The retorted lines in a play carry the heat of a quarrel.
normal.cn: 剧本里标着 retorted 的台词，总是带着争吵的火气。

normal.en: The chemical retort has a neck bent back, just like the answer.
normal.cn: 化学用的曲颈瓶瓶颈向后弯，正如那句被顶回去的回答。

abstract.en: See a ping-pong ball hit back harder than it came.
abstract.cn: 想象一个乒乓球被击回时比来时更猛。

abstract.en: Picture a fishhook that comes back with teeth.
abstract.cn: 想象一个鱼钩被扔回去时还带着尖牙。

abstract.en: Imagine steam curling back down the bent glass neck.
abstract.cn: 想象蒸汽顺着弯折的玻璃瓶颈往回流。

examples.en: When the coach blamed the strikers, the captain retorted that the defence had been asleep.
examples.cn: 教练怪罪前锋，队长立刻回敬说后防线在梦游。

examples.en: His retort was so quick that nobody could answer it.
examples.cn: 他的回敬快得没人接得上。

examples.en: The chemists heated the mixture in a glass retort.
examples.cn: 化学家们在玻璃曲颈瓶里加热混合物。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞道特」——对方一说，你立马「特」别快地回敬过去；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（向后）+ torquere（扭）→ retorquere（扭回去）→ 法语 → 英语 retort；核心义「把话、把器皿的颈反扭回去」。同根词有 distort、torture、torsion、torment。

sensesIntro.en: Retort starts with a snapped-back reply, then names that reply, then the same twist applied to a retaliatory act and to a flask and industrial vessel with a bent neck.
sensesIntro.cn: retort 先指顶回去的回答，再指那句回答本身，然后把同样的「反扭」扩展到对等的回敬、曲颈瓶和工业蒸馏罐。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an answer twisted sharply back on the person who asked.
core.cn: 核心意象：一句回答被尖锐地拧回到发问者脸上。

branches.en: To reply sharply is the core verbal action.
branches.cn: 尖锐回话是核心的言语动作。

branches.en: The noun names the sentence that snapped back.
branches.cn: 名词指那句被弹回去的话。

branches.en: The flask and the industrial vessel repeat the bent neck.
branches.cn: 曲颈瓶与工业容器重复了「弯颈」的意象。

branches.en: Replying sharply shades into turning a charge against its maker.
branches.cn: 尖锐回话可以延伸为把指控还给指控者。

branches.en: A verbal retort and a formal like for like are both returns.
branches.cn: 言语回敬与正式文体中的对等回击都是「返回」。

intro.en: Retort is built from the Latin prefix re- and the root torquere, to twist, with the same root behind distort, torture and torsion.
intro.cn: retort 由拉丁前缀 re- 与词根 torquere（扭）构成，同根词有 distort、torture、torsion。

latinIntro.en: Latin retorquere means to twist back, and the medieval Latin retorta named a rounded vessel.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 retorquere 意为「扭回去」，中古拉丁语 retorta 则指一种圆形器皿。

items.example: The prefix re- sends the answer back.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 把回答送回去。

items.example: Torquere is the twisting core of retort.
items.exampleCN: torquere 是 retort 中「扭」的核心。

items.example: Retorquere joins the prefix and the root.
items.exampleCN: retorquere 把前缀和词根合在一起。

items.example: Retorta gives the flask sense.

items.example: The suffix -ion forms retortion.
