definition_zh: 削减开支；裁员节流；缩减；（军队的）防御工事
definition_en: the act of reducing spending, staff or activity in order to save money and survive
core_image: 一堆铺开的开销被一把把往外抽，只剩下最里面的核心
scene: 公司账上连年亏损，董事会砍掉了海外分部、砍掉了新办公楼，最后连年会也被取消。 The retrenchment at the firm ended overseas offices, a new tower and even the annual party.
sceneCN: 这里 retrenchment 是「削减开支、收缩规模」（第 1 个义项：企业为省钱而裁撤开支与业务）；句意：这家公司的收缩让海外分部、新办公楼甚至年会都泡了汤。

pos.zh: 削减开支；裁员节流；缩减
防御工事；壕堑

derivatives.zh: 削减开支；裁减人员；挖壕自卫，是 retrenchment 的动词基础
可削减的；可紧缩的，由 retrench 加 -able 构成
壕沟；战壕，是 retrench 的截短形式所对应的名词

senses.title: Cutting costs to survive
senses.definition: the practice of reducing costs, spending or activity so that an organization can stay afloat
senses.definitionCN: 为让机构支撑下去而减少成本、开支或活动的做法
senses.example: The group announced a retrenchment of its overseas operations.
senses.exampleCN: 该集团宣布收缩海外业务。
senses.why: French retranchier means to cut off, so the word pictures budget lines being sliced away.
senses.whyCN: 法语 retranchier 意为「切掉」，所以这个词的画面是预算条目一条条被切走。

senses.title: Cutting the workforce
senses.definition: the dismissal or reduction of employees as part of a cost-saving move
senses.definitionCN: 作为省钱措施而解雇或减少员工
senses.example: Half the factory faced retrenchment by spring.
senses.exampleCN: 到春天，工厂一半的人面临裁员。
senses.why: The first thing a company slices away in a crisis is its payroll, so the cut becomes people.
senses.whyCN: 危机中公司最先切掉的往往是工资开支，于是「切」落到了人身上。

senses.title: Personal austerity
senses.definition: a period in which a person or family spends much less than before
senses.definitionCN: 个人或家庭花得比以前少得多的时期
senses.example: After the loan, the couple entered a year of quiet retrenchment.
senses.exampleCN: 还完贷款后，这对夫妻过了省钱的一年。
senses.why: The cutting-off image works for a household as well as for a company: what you do not need, you cut.
senses.whyCN: 「切掉」的画面同样适用于家庭：不需要的，就削掉。

senses.title: Shrinking scope
senses.definition: the narrowing of an activity, plan or policy back to a smaller and safer scope
senses.definitionCN: 把某项活动、计划或政策收回到更小、更稳妥的范围
senses.example: The retrenchment of the research plan disappointed the team.
senses.exampleCN: 研究计划的收缩让团队很失望。
senses.why: Plans are cut the way budgets are: the outside edges go first and the plan shrinks toward its middle.
senses.whyCN: 计划的削减和预算一样：先切掉外围，再向中间收缩。

senses.title: A defensive line
senses.definition: an inner line of defences or a trench built inside an outer one
senses.definitionCN: 在外层工事之内加筑的防御线或壕沟
senses.example: The soldiers dug a retrenchment behind the wall.
senses.exampleCN: 士兵在墙后挖了一道内壕。
senses.why: The earliest use is military: cutting off a piece of ground and fencing it for defence.
senses.whyCN: 最早的用法是军事的：切出一块土地，围起来防守。

senses.title: Organizational retreat
senses.titleCN: 机构层面的退缩与保守化
senses.definition: a general turning inward and cautious in the culture or strategy of an institution
senses.definitionCN: 机构在文化或战略上整体转向内向、保守
senses.example: Critics saw the hiring freeze as a cultural retrenchment.
senses.exampleCN: 批评者把冻结招聘看作一种文化上的退缩。
senses.why: The defence line and the budget cut share one move: pull everything back behind a shorter line.
senses.whyCN: 防御线和预算削减是同一个动作：把一切收回到更短的战线之内。

intro.en: Retrenchment grows out of retrench, from Old French retranchier, to cut off or cut down, from Latin re- back plus truncare, to cut.
intro.cn: retrenchment 来自动词 retrench，源于古法语 retranchier「切掉、削减」，再上溯拉丁语 re-（向后）与 truncare（切断）。

items.en: Truncare means to cut or lop off, and re- means back.
items.cn: truncare 意为切断、砍去，re- 表示向后。

items.en: Retranchier means to cut off or to separate a piece of ground.
items.cn: retranchier 意为切掉，或圈出、切开一块土地。

items.en: Retrenchment first names a defensive trench inside a position.
items.cn: retrenchment 最初指阵地内部加筑的防御壕沟。

items.en: The meaning widens from cutting ground to cutting spending.
items.cn: 词义从「切土地」扩展到「切开支」。

items.en: Business and public finance make retrenchment a routine word for austerity.
items.cn: 商业与公共财政让 retrenchment 成了紧缩的常用词。

items.en: Today it covers layoffs, budgets and inward-looking organisations.
items.cn: 现代英语中，它涵盖裁员、预算与机构的内向收缩。

note.en: Retrenchment belongs to the cut-and-shrink family, with the trench at its heart and economy words around it.
note.cn: retrenchment 属于「切与缩」的词族，核心藏着 trench（壕沟），周围是各种节约与收缩词。

entries.definition: to cut down expenditure or staff
entries.definitionCN: 削减开支或人员，是名词的动词基础。

entries.definition: a long narrow ditch
entries.definitionCN: 沟；战壕，与 retrench 共享「切」的词根。

entries.definition: the state of being firmly fixed or dug in
entries.definitionCN: 根深蒂固；掘壕固守，前缀不同、方向相反。

entries.definition: the act of getting something back
entries.definitionCN: 取回；检索：只是拼写开头相似，词源不同。

entries.definition: government policy of severe spending cuts
entries.definitionCN: 紧缩政策，多用于国家财政层面。

entries.definition: a reduction in spending or services
entries.definitionCN: 削减，偏指单项服务的减少。

entries.definition: reducing staff numbers
entries.definitionCN: 精简人员，专指人而不是钱。

normalIntro.en: Retrenchment is the noun for what retrench does: cutting back spending, staff or scope, and the trench inside it is the oldest picture.
normalIntro.cn: retrenchment 是 retrench 的名词形式：削开支、减人员、缩范围，而其中的 trench（壕沟）是最古老的画面。

normal.en: The re- prefix says back, and trench says a cut ditch.
normal.cn: 前缀 re- 表示「往回收」，trench 表示挖出的沟，合起来就是往里切。

normal.en: Retrenchment is used with corporate, spending and staff.
normal.cn: retrenchment 常与 corporate、spending、staff 搭配。

normal.en: The verb retrench is the base, and -ment turns it into a noun.
normal.cn: 动词是 retrench，加 -ment 就变成名词。

normal.en: Modern headlines use retrenchment for layoffs and budget cuts.
normal.cn: 现代新闻标题里，retrenchment 就是裁员和砍预算。

normal.en: Compare entrenchment: one digs in, the other cuts back.
normal.cn: 对比 entrenchment：一个往里埋、扎根固守，一个往外切、削减。

abstract.en: Picture a plant clipped back to its stem to survive winter.
abstract.cn: 想象一株植物被剪到只剩主干，好熬过冬天。

abstract.en: Imagine a shop closing one display window after another.
abstract.cn: 想象一家店一个接一个地关掉橱窗。

abstract.en: See a person folding a big map down to a small square.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人把大地图折成一小块。

examples.en: The retrenchment saved the company from bankruptcy.
examples.cn: 这次削减开支使公司免于破产。

examples.en: Several retrenchments followed the lost contract.
examples.cn: 丢掉那份合同后，公司接连做了一轮又一轮的收缩。

examples.en: Economists warned that retrenchment would slow recovery.
examples.cn: 经济学家警告说，紧缩会让复苏变慢。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「锐剪门——」——拿着一把「锐」利的剪子，「门」口一条条剪掉开销；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（向后）+ truncare（切）→ 古法语 retranchier（切掉；圈地）→ 英语 retrench → retrenchment；核心义「切掉、收回到更短的一线」，因而兼有军事壕堑与削减开支两义。同族词有 trench、entrench、truncate。

sensesIntro.en: Retrenchment begins with the cut: costs first, then people, then personal spending and scope, and the oldest of all is the trench dug inside a defensive line.
sensesIntro.cn: retrenchment 从「切」出发：先切开支，再裁人，再是个人节约与范围收缩，而最古老的义项是在防线内侧挖的壕沟。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pile of spending sliced back until only the core remains.
core.cn: 核心意象：一大堆开支被一片片切掉，只剩最核心的部分。

branches.en: Cutting costs is the commercial core sense.
branches.cn: 削减开支是商业上的核心义。

branches.en: The cut reaches people and households as well as budgets.
branches.cn: 这种「切」既落在人身上，也落在家庭开销上。

branches.en: Layoffs and a closed culture are the same retreat behind a shorter line.
branches.cn: 裁员与文化上的保守，都是退到更短战线之后。

branches.en: Shrinking scope and inward strategy both narrow what the organisation does.
branches.cn: 收缩范围与内向战略都在缩小机构的作为。

branches.en: The military trench is the concrete origin of the abstract cut.
branches.cn: 军事壕沟是这种抽象「切」的具体源头。

intro.en: Retrenchment is the verb retrench plus the noun suffix -ment, with an old French cut at its base.
intro.cn: retrenchment 是动词 retrench 加名词词尾 -ment 构成，底部是一个古法语「切」的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin re- back plus truncare to cut gives the cutting sense behind retrench and its medieval trench.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 re-（向后）加 truncare（切断），构成 retrench 及其后起的 trench 的「切」义。

items.example: The prefix re- means back in retrench.
items.exampleCN: 在 retrench 中，前缀 re- 表示「向后」。

items.example: Truncare provides the cutting core.
items.exampleCN: truncare 提供「切」的核心。

items.example: Truncus gives the image of a cut stump.
items.exampleCN: truncus 给出「砍下的树桩」意象。

items.meaning: to cut off or cut down
items.example: Retranchier is the immediate French ancestor.
items.exampleCN: retranchier 是直接的法语祖先。

items.example: Retrench carries the verb sense.
items.exampleCN: retrench 承担动词义。

items.example: The suffix -ment forms retrenchment.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ment 构成 retrenchment。

items.example: Trench is the cut itself.
items.exampleCN: trench 就是那道被切出的沟。

items.meaning: to dig in or fix firmly
items.example: Entrench digs in where retrench cuts back.
items.exampleCN: entrench 向内扎根，retrench 向外削减。

items.example: Truncate is the plain cut of the family.
items.exampleCN: truncate 是词族中最直接的「切」。

definition_zh: 取回；找回；检索数据；（从记忆中）想起；挽回；挽救
definition_en: to get something back, especially something that was lost, dropped or stored somewhere
core_image: 一只靴子从泥沙里被拽回来，抖掉水又回到手里
scene: 狗冲进冰冷的河里，叼起那根漂走的木棍，甩着水回到岸边。 The dog dived into the cold river and retrieved the drifting stick for its owner.
sceneCN: 这里 retrieve 是「取回、找回」（第 1 个义项：把丢失的东西拿回来）；句意：狗跳进冷河，替主人把漂走的木棍叼了回来。

pos.zh: 取回；找回；检索
挽回；补救（书面）

derivatives.zh: 取回；检索；记忆提取，由 retrieve 加名词词尾 -al 构成
可取回的；可检索的，retrieve 加 -able
寻回犬；取回者，retrieve 加施事词尾 -er
无法挽回的；无可补救的，ir- 否定前缀加 retrievable

senses.title: To get something back
senses.definition: to bring back something that was lost, dropped or left behind
senses.definitionCN: 把丢失、掉落或被落下的东西带回来
senses.example: He waded in to retrieve his hat from the stream.
senses.exampleCN: 他蹚进溪水去把自己的帽子捞回来。
senses.why: French retrouver means to find again, and re- again plus trouver to find gives the simple act of recovery.
senses.whyCN: 法语 retrouver 意为「重新找到」，前缀「再次」加「找到」，所以最基本的义项就是拿回。

senses.title: To look data up
senses.definition: to find and bring up stored information, such as a file, record or web page
senses.definitionCN: 找出并调出储存的信息，例如文件、记录或网页
senses.example: The program retrieves records by date.
senses.exampleCN: 这个程序按日期检索记录。
senses.why: A file is found again in the same way a hat is: it was there, put away, and now it is brought back.
senses.whyCN: 文件被找回的方式和帽子一样：它一直在那里，被放好了，现在又被取出。

senses.title: To call back to mind
senses.definition: to bring information or a memory back into consciousness
senses.definitionCN: 把信息或记忆重新唤回意识里
senses.example: I could not retrieve the name of that street.
senses.exampleCN: 我怎么也想不起那条街的名字。
senses.why: Memory works like a storehouse: the item was there all along, and retrieval means fetching it out again.
senses.whyCN: 记忆就像一个仓库：东西一直存在，想起就是把它们重新取出来。

senses.title: To recover what was lost
senses.definition: to recover objects or people from the water, wreckage or a damaged area
senses.definitionCN: 从水中、残骸或受灾地区找出并救回物品或人员
senses.example: Divers retrieved the black box from the seabed.
senses.exampleCN: 潜水员从海床打捞出了黑匣子。
senses.why: When the thing is buried in water or wreckage, the same fetch becomes a rescue done against gravity.
senses.whyCN: 当东西被埋在水或残骸下，「取回」就成了与阻力对抗的打捞与救援。

senses.title: To put something right
senses.definition: in formal use, to make good a loss, mistake or bad reputation
senses.definitionCN: 在正式文体中，弥补损失、错误或挽救名誉
senses.example: One good match could retrieve the season for them.
senses.exampleCN: 一场好球就能让他们整个赛季起死回生。
senses.why: The find-again image widens to abstract things: a lost reputation can also be found again.
senses.whyCN: 「重新找到」的画面扩展到抽象事物：丢掉的名声同样可以被找回来。

senses.title: The hunting dog returns
senses.definition: of a trained dog, to go and fetch shot game or a thrown object
senses.definitionCN: 指受过训练的狗去把打下的猎物或抛出的东西叼回来
senses.example: The retriever retrieved three ducks from the marsh.
senses.exampleCN: 那只寻回犬从沼泽里叼回了三只野鸭。
senses.why: Around the fifteenth century the word was used of a hound that brings shot game back, and the dog took the name.
senses.whyCN: 十五世纪前后，这个词用来指把猎物叼回的猎犬，狗也因此得了 retriever 这个名字。

intro.en: Retrieve comes through Middle English retreven from Old French retrouver, to find again, built on re- again and trouver, to find.
intro.cn: retrieve 经中古英语 retreven 来自古法语 retrouver「重新找到」，由 re-（再次）与 trouver（找到）构成。

items.en: A reconstructed popular Latin verb behind trouver is generally related to tropare, to turn and find.
items.cn: trouver 背后的俗拉丁动词属重构形式，一般认为与 tropare（转、找）相关。

items.en: Retrouver means to find again or recover something lost.
items.cn: retrouver 意为重新找到、寻回失物。

items.en: Retreven carries the verb into English with the same sense.
items.cn: 中古英语 retreven 把动词带入英语，意思不变。

items.en: Retrieve is used for the hound that brings game back.
items.cn: 到十五世纪，retrieve 用来指猎犬把猎物叼回。

items.en: The abstract sense of making good a loss appears.
items.cn: 「弥补损失、挽回」的抽象义出现。

items.en: Twentieth-century computing adds the retrieval of stored data.
items.cn: 二十世纪的计算机技术补充了「检索数据」的义项。

note.en: Retrieve shares a beginning with many re- words and the find-again idea with words for recovering what is lost.
note.cn: retrieve 与许多 re- 开头的词共用前缀，又与表示「找回、恢复」的词共享「重新找到」的思路。

entries.definition: the act of getting information or objects back
entries.definitionCN: 取回或检索的行为，由 retrieve 派生。

entries.definition: a dog trained to fetch game
entries.definitionCN: 寻回犬，由 retrieve 加 -er 构成。

entries.definition: to move back from a position
entries.definitionCN: 撤退：只是拼写相近，词源不同，没有「取回」的意思。

entries.definition: to withdraw a statement or pull something back
entries.definitionCN: 撤回；缩回：同用 re- 前缀，但词根是拖拉的 trahere，词源不同。

entries.definition: to get something back after losing it
entries.definitionCN: 找回；恢复，最通用的「失而复得」。

entries.definition: to save something from damage or wreck
entries.definitionCN: 抢救；打捞，强调从损毁中救出。

entries.definition: to bring a memory back to mind
entries.definitionCN: 回忆；想起，专用于记忆而非物件。

normalIntro.en: Retrieve is the find-again word: re- says back, and the French root says to find, so it covers hats, files and memories.
normalIntro.cn: retrieve 就是「重新找到」：re- 表示回来，法语词根表示找到，所以帽子、文件、记忆都能用它。

normal.en: The re- prefix here means again, not merely back.
normal.cn: 这里的前缀 re- 强调「再次」，不只是「往回」。

normal.en: The noun is retrieval, and the dog is a retriever.
normal.cn: 名词是 retrieval，叼东西的狗叫 retriever。

normal.en: Retrieve is common with data, files, information and records.
normal.cn: retrieve 常与 data、files、information、records 搭配。

normal.en: Irretrievable means it cannot be found again, so it is lost for good.
normal.cn: irretrievable 表示再也找不回来，也就是彻底失去。

normal.en: Compare r e c o v e r: recover is broader, retrieve is more specific and technical.
normal.cn: 对比 recover：recover 更笼统，retrieve 更具体、更技术化。

abstract.en: Picture a fishing line pulling a sunken bucket back up.
abstract.cn: 想象一根钓线把沉下的桶重新拉了上来。

abstract.en: See a glow in a dark warehouse as one shelf lights up.
abstract.cn: 想象漆黑仓库里，只有一格货架亮了起来。

abstract.en: Feel a name surfacing from the dark water of memory.
abstract.cn: 感受一个名字从记忆的深水里慢慢浮上来。

examples.en: Firefighters retrieved two passengers from the burning car.
examples.cn: 消防员从燃烧的车里救出了两名乘客。

examples.en: The system can retrieve any invoice within seconds.
examples.cn: 这个系统几秒钟内就能调出任何一张发票。

examples.en: She retrieved her reputation with a quiet apology.
examples.cn: 她以一次低调的道歉挽回了自己的名声。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞提夫」——叫「瑞」的提夫拎着桶去把掉进井里的东西提回来；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古法语 retrouver（重新找到）= re-（再次）+ trouver（找到）；trouver 上溯一个俗拉丁动词（属重构形式），通常再与 tropare（转）相联系，该路径属一般假说。核心义「重新拿回」。同族词有 retrieval、retriever、irretrievable。

sensesIntro.en: Retrieve starts with getting a thing back, then applies to stored data and memory, to rescues from water and wreckage, to a reputation that must be regained, and to the dog that fetches the game.
sensesIntro.cn: retrieve 先指把东西拿回来，再扩展到检索数据和回忆，扩展到从水里、残骸中救回，扩展到挽回名声，最后是猎犬把猎物叼回。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something lost is found again and brought back to the hand.
core.cn: 核心意象：丢失的东西被重新找到，又回到手中。

branches.en: Getting a thing back is the core act, whether from a stream or a wreck.
branches.cn: 把东西拿回来是核心动作，无论从溪里还是从残骸里。

branches.en: Stored data is found again out of a filing system.
branches.cn: 储存的数据是被从文件系统里重新找到的。

branches.en: Files and memories are both kept somewhere and fetched on demand.
branches.cn: 文件和记忆都存放在某处，需要时被调出。

branches.en: The hunting dog does the plain retrieve, only with its mouth.
branches.cn: 猎犬做的正是最基本的「取回」，只是用嘴。

branches.en: A regained reputation and a fetched duck are both something brought back.
branches.cn: 挽回的名声和叼回的野鸭，都是被「带回」的东西。

intro.en: Retrieve is built from the French prefix re- and trouver, to find, with retrieval, retrievable, retriever and irretrievable growing from it.
intro.cn: retrieve 由法语前缀 re- 与 trouver（找到）构成，围绕它长出 retrieval、retrievable、retriever、irretrievable。

latinIntro.en: The French verb retrouver has no secure Latin ancestor, so the popular Latin word behind trouver is marked as reconstructed and only generally related to tropare.
latinIntro.cn: 法语 retrouver 没有可靠的拉丁祖先，trouver 背后的俗拉丁词只能标为重构形式，并且一般认为只与 tropare 相关。

items.example: The prefix re- says find again.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 表示「再次找到」。

items.example: Trouver supplies the find.
items.exampleCN: trouver 提供「找到」。

items.example: Retrouver is the direct French ancestor.
items.exampleCN: retrouver 是直接的法语祖先。

items.example: Retrieve keeps the find-again meaning.
items.exampleCN: retrieve 保留「重新找到」的含义。

items.example: The suffix -al forms retrieval.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -al 构成 retrieval。

items.example: The suffix -able forms retrievable.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -able 构成 retrievable。

items.example: The suffix -er forms retriever.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -er 构成 retriever。

items.example: Ir- plus retrievable makes irretrievable.
items.exampleCN: ir- 加 retrievable 构成 irretrievable。

items.example: Irretrievable describes irreversible loss.
items.exampleCN: irretrievable 描述不可挽回的损失。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 转；找到（路径属一般假说）

definition_zh: 回顾；回溯；对往事的反思
definition_en: the act of looking back at what has already happened and thinking about it carefully
core_image: 一个人站在路的尽头，回头望向自己刚走过的那一段
scene: 退休的老教师在旧书堆里坐了一下午。Her long retrospection on twenty years of teaching ended in a quiet smile.
sceneCN: 这里 retrospection 是「回顾、反思」（第 2 个义项：对往事的仔细回顾与省思）；句意：她对二十年教学生涯的长长回顾最后化作一个浅浅的微笑。

pos.zh: 回顾；回溯；反思

derivatives.zh: 回顾；回想（同根词，名动同形）
回顾的；回想式的；回顾展
回溯地；事后看来
内省；往内看（同根，方向相反）

senses.title: Looking back at something that has passed
senses.definition: the act of looking back at events or periods that are already over
senses.definitionCN: 把目光转回已经结束的事件或时段
senses.example: The book opens with a retrospection on the writer early years.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书以对作家早年岁月的回顾开篇。
senses.why: Retro- means backward, so the word literally turns the gaze around to what lies behind.
senses.whyCN: retro- 表示「向后」，这个词就是把目光转回去，落在身后的东西上。

senses.title: Careful thought about the past
senses.definition: mature reflection on past decisions and experiences in order to learn from them
senses.definitionCN: 对过去的决定与经历作成熟的思考，以便从中学习
senses.example: A little retrospection would have saved the team from the same mistake.
senses.exampleCN: 稍作反思，团队本可避免重蹈覆辙。
senses.why: Because the looking back is deliberate, retrospection becomes a kind of study of one own history.
senses.whyCN: 回头看的动作是有意的，于是回顾就变成对自己经历的研究与检讨。

senses.title: A backward view in time
senses.titleCN: 回溯的视角；回溯性观察
senses.definition: a way of viewing a development by tracing it backwards from its results
senses.definitionCN: 从结果出发倒着追溯发展过程的一种观察方式
senses.example: In retrospection the reform looks smoother than it felt at the time.
senses.exampleCN: 回头看来，那场改革比当时感觉的要顺利得多。
senses.why: The noun also names the standpoint itself, the standpoint of someone standing at the end and looking back.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也指视角本身，即站在终点回头看的那个角度。

senses.title: A written or spoken review
senses.definition: a passage in a book, speech, or film that summarises earlier events
senses.definitionCN: 书、演讲或影片中概述先前事件的段落
senses.example: A brief retrospection in the final chapter gathers the loose ends.
senses.exampleCN: 末章的一段简短追述把散落的线索收拢起来。
senses.why: When the backward look is written down or spoken aloud, it becomes a piece of narrative.
senses.whyCN: 当回望被写下来或说出口，它就成了一段叙事。

intro.en: Retrospection is a learned formation from Latin retro, backwards, and specere, to look, modelled on the older word introspection.
intro.cn: retrospection 是学术化的构词，由拉丁语 retro（向后）与 specere（看）组成，模仿更早的 introspection 而造。

items.en: Retro is a Latin prefix meaning backwards.
items.cn: retro 是拉丁语前缀，意为「向后」。

items.en: Specere means to look, and gives spectrum and speculum.
items.cn: specere 意为「看」，也给出 spectrum 与 speculum。

items.en: Later Latin retrospectare means to look back.
items.cn: 较晚的拉丁语 retrospectare 意为「往回看」。

items.en: Retrospect appears in English in the early seventeenth century.
items.cn: retrospect 于十七世纪初出现在英语中。

items.en: Retrospection is coined on the pattern of introspection, with the abstract ending -ion.
items.cn: retrospection 仿照 introspection 而造，加上抽象名词词尾 -ion。

items.en: Modern English adds the adjective retrospective and the adverb retrospectively.
items.cn: 现代英语又增加了形容词 retrospective 与副词 retrospectively。

note.en: Retrospection belongs to the same Latin looking family as introspect and prospect, and it sits close to nostalgia, hindsight, and review.
note.cn: retrospection 与 introspect、prospect 同属拉丁语「看」的词族，意义上与 nostalgia、hindsight、review 相邻。

entries.definition: a look back at past events, often in the phrase in retrospect
entries.definitionCN: 回顾过去；常用于短语 in retrospect（事后看来）

entries.definition: looking back on or dealing with past events
entries.definitionCN: 回顾的；涉及往事的；也指回顾展

entries.definition: the examination of ones own thoughts and feelings
entries.definitionCN: 内省；审视自己的思想和感受，方向与 retrospection 相反

entries.definition: a rare technical word for something that moves backward
entries.definitionCN: 极罕见的术语，只借用 retro- 前缀，词根与本词不同，只是前缀相近

entries.definition: the act of recalling past experiences, often fondly
entries.definitionCN: 回忆往事；常带温情色彩，偏重回忆本身而非检讨

entries.definition: understanding of an event only after it has happened
entries.definitionCN: 事后认识；事后的明智

entries.definition: serious thought about something, including ones own conduct
entries.definitionCN: 反思；深思，既可指向内也可指向外

normalIntro.en: Retrospection is the looking-back word: retro turns the gaze around, spec- supplies the act of seeing.
normalIntro.cn: retrospection 是一个「往回看」的词：retro 把目光转回去，spec- 提供「看」这个动作。

normal.en: Retro- means backward in retrograde and retroactive.
normal.cn: retro- 在 retrograde、retroactive 中都表示「向后」。

normal.en: The root spec- means to look, as in inspect and spectacle.
normal.cn: 词根 spec- 意为「看」，如 inspect 与 spectacle。

normal.en: Introspection looks inside, retrospection looks behind.
normal.cn: introspection 往里看，retrospection 往回看。

normal.en: The phrase in retrospect is the everyday cousin of retrospection.
normal.cn: 短语 in retrospect 是 retrospection 的日常说法。

normal.en: Compare review, which checks the past for accuracy, with retrospection, which thinks about meaning.
normal.cn: 对比 review：它核对过去以求准确，retrospection 则思考过去的意义。

abstract.en: Picture a traveller at the top of a hill, turning to look down the winding road.
abstract.cn: 想象一位旅人站在山顶，转过身俯瞰那条蜿蜒来路。

abstract.en: Imagine a teacher marking her own old essays, nodding at how far she has come.
abstract.cn: 想象一位老师翻看自己旧日的文章，为你走过的路而点头。

abstract.en: Think of a film replaying the last scene in reverse before the credits roll.
abstract.cn: 想象片尾字幕前的最后一个镜头被倒放着重播一遍。

examples.en: Periods of retrospection help a writer see which habits still serve her.
examples.cn: 时常回顾有助于作家看清哪些写作习惯仍然有用。

examples.en: His retrospection on the failed expedition was honest and unsentimental.
examples.cn: 他对那次失败的远征的回顾既诚实又不带感伤。

examples.en: The museum curates a season of retrospection on the city industrial past.
examples.cn: 博物馆策划了一季关于这座城市工业往事的回顾展映。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞球往回滚」——球往回滚，目光也跟着往回看，就是回顾；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 retro（向后）+ specere（看）→ 晚期拉丁 retrospectare（往回看）→ 英语 retrospect → retrospective → retrospection，仿 introspection 而加抽象词尾 -ion，核心义「回头看」。

sensesIntro.en: Retrospection starts as the mere backward gaze, narrows into deliberate reflection, then widens again into a standpoint and a piece of narrative.
sensesIntro.cn: retrospection 从单纯往回看的动作起步，收窄为有意的反思，再扩展为一种视角和一段追述。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person standing at the end of a road, looking back the way they came.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人站在路的尽头，回头望向自己走来的方向。

branches.en: The plain act of looking back at what is over.
branches.cn: 对已结束之事最简单的那一下回望。

branches.en: The deliberate, evaluative reflection on past choices.
branches.cn: 对过去选择的有意评估与思考。

branches.en: The standpoint itself, seeing history from its end.
branches.cn: 视角本身，即从终点回看历史的位置。

branches.en: The told or written form of the backward look.
branches.cn: 回望被说出或写下的叙事形态。

branches.en: Most retrospection begins as a simple look and turns into reflection.
branches.cn: 多数的回顾都从一眼回望开始，再转入反思。

intro.en: Retrospection is built from the Latin prefix retro- and the looking root -spect, with a full family of retro- words around it.
intro.cn: retrospection 由拉丁语前缀 retro- 与表示「看」的词根 -spect 构成，周边还有一整族 retro- 词。

latinIntro.en: Latin retro means backwards, and specere means to look, so a ratio back-plus-look is the whole story.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 retro 意为向后，specere 意为看，所以「向后＋看」的组合就是全部。

items.example: The prefix retro- sets the backward direction.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 retro- 定下向后的方向。

items.example: The root spec- contributes the act of seeing.
items.exampleCN: 词根 spec- 提供看的动作。

items.example: In retrospect, the choice was obvious.
items.exampleCN: 事后看来，那个选择显而易见。

items.example: The suffix -ive forms retrospective.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ive 构成 retrospective。

items.example: The suffix -ion turns retrospect into retrospection.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ion 把 retrospect 变成 retrospection。

items.meaningCN: 有追溯力的；溯及既往的
items.example: The new tax rule is retroactive to January.
items.exampleCN: 新税规可追溯至一月。

items.example: Retrospect as a verb is rare today.
items.exampleCN: retrospect 作动词如今很少见。

items.example: The gallery held a retrospective of her paintings.
items.exampleCN: 画廊为她举办了绘画回顾展。

items.meaning: the examination of ones own mind
items.example: Introspection shares the root but looks inward.
items.exampleCN: introspection 词根相同，但方向朝内。

items.example: The suffix -ness forms retrospection like nouns of state.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ness 可构成表示状态的名词，与 retrospection 同类。

definition_zh: 重逢；团聚；聚会；（组织上的）重新联合
definition_en: the act of coming together again after being apart, or a gathering of people who have been separated
core_image: 两块原本分开的磁铁，“啪”地一声又吸回了原处
scene: 火车站的出站口，老人举着写满字的纸板站了很久。The reunion of mother and son after ten years lasted only a few seconds of silence.
sceneCN: 这里 reunion 是「重逢、团聚」（第 1 个义项：分离的人或物重新聚到一起）；句意：分开十年后母子重逢，先是几秒钟的沉默。

pos.zh: 重逢；团聚；聚会；重新联合

derivatives.zh: 重聚；重新联合（逆构动词，先有名词后回推）
重新统一的（由 reunify 派生）
重新统一（re- + unification）
联合；联盟；工会（基础名词，re- 的反义面）

senses.title: Coming together again after separation
senses.definition: the act of people who have been apart meeting one another again
senses.definitionCN: 分开的人再次相见的行为
senses.example: Their reunion at the airport drew applause from strangers.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在机场的重逢让素不相识的人都鼓起掌来。
senses.why: Re- means again and unio means a joining, so a reunion is a joining that happens a second time.
senses.whyCN: re- 表示「再一次」，unio 表示「结合」，所以 reunion 是第二次完成的结合。

senses.title: A gathering of former friends
senses.definition: an organised event at which people who once knew each other meet up again
senses.definitionCN: 旧相识为再次见面而组织的活动
senses.example: She flew home for a school reunion and met her old captain.
senses.exampleCN: 她飞回家乡参加同学聚会，见到了当年的班长。
senses.why: Once the joining is put on a calendar and booked in a hall, the reunion becomes a fixed event.
senses.whyCN: 当「重聚」被写进日历、订下会场，它就固定成了一场活动。

senses.title: The joining of parts into a whole again
senses.definition: the return of separated parts, regions, or groups to a single whole
senses.definitionCN: 被分开的部分、地区或团体重新回到一个整体
senses.example: The reunion of the two branches took years of patient talks.
senses.exampleCN: 两个分支重新合并花了多年耐心的谈判。
senses.why: The old Latin unio means one, so reunion can also describe things, not only people, being made one again.
senses.whyCN: 古拉丁语 unio 意为「一」，所以 reunion 也能描述「物」重新合而为一。

senses.title: A reconciliation of feelings
senses.titleCN: 情感上的和解；再度亲近
senses.definition: the restoration of warmth between people who had grown distant or quarrelled
senses.definitionCN: 关系疏远或吵翻的人之间重新恢复亲密
senses.example: The two sisters marked their reunion with a long walk by the river.
senses.exampleCN: 姐妹俩用一次沿河的长时间散步来纪念和好。
senses.why: Distance between two minds can be closed the way distance between two places is, so a coming-together can be emotional.
senses.whyCN: 两处地方的距离可以缩短，两颗心也可以，于是「重聚」自然能指情感上的靠近。

intro.en: Reunion joins the Latin prefix re-, again, to Latin unio, a union or unit, and came into English through French.
intro.cn: reunion 由拉丁语前缀 re-（再一次）与拉丁语 unio（联合、一）结合而成，经法语进入英语。

items.en: Unus means one, and unio means a union or oneness.
items.cn: unus 意为「一」，unio 意为合而为一。

items.en: Re- adds the notion of doing something a second time.
items.cn: re- 加进来，表示「再做一次」。

items.en: French reunit forms the verb and reunion the noun.
items.cn: 法语用 reunir 构成动词、用 reunion 构成名词。

items.en: Reunion first names the bringing together of things separated.
items.cn: reunion 最初指把分开之物重新聚拢。

items.en: The modern sense of a gathering of former classmates or relatives develops.
items.cn: 「同学、亲属聚会」的现代义在此期发展出来。

items.en: Reunite is later back-formed from reunion, not the other way round.
items.cn: reunite 后来由 reunion 逆构而成，而非相反。

note.en: Reunion sits beside union and unite on the one hand and alongside reunion types such as gathering and homecoming on the other.
note.cn: reunion 一面与 union、unite 同族，一面又与 gathering、homecoming 这类「相聚」词相邻。

entries.definition: to join together into one
entries.definitionCN: 联合；团结（基础动词，reunion 的核心是它）

entries.definition: the joining of two or more things into one
entries.definitionCN: 联合；联盟；工会

entries.definition: to bring divided parts together into one whole again
entries.definitionCN: 重新统一；再合并

entries.definition: the destruction or collapse of something
entries.definitionCN: 毁坏；废墟，只是拼写与读音相近，词源无关，意思更是反面

entries.definition: a meeting of people, often for a shared purpose
entries.definitionCN: 聚会；集会，不一定含「曾分开」的前提

entries.definition: a return to home after time away, often celebrated
entries.definitionCN: 归乡；返校节，侧重「回家」而非双方见面

entries.definition: the restoring of friendly relations after a quarrel
entries.definitionCN: 和解；侧重于矛盾消解，不强调见面

normalIntro.en: Reunion is re- plus union: the union is simply done over again.
normalIntro.cn: reunion 就是 re- 加上 union：只不过把「联合」再做一次。

normal.en: Re- means again, as in rebuild, renew, and retell.
normal.cn: re- 表示「再一次」，如 rebuild、renew、retell。

normal.en: Union is the noun of unite, so reunion is a second uniting.
normal.cn: union 是 unite 的名词，因此 reunion 就是再次 unite。

normal.en: A family reunion is the commonest collocation in speech.
normal.cn: family reunion 是口语里最常见的搭配。

normal.en: The verb reunite was formed from this noun by dropping the ending.
normal.cn: 动词 reunite 是从这个名词去尾逆构出来的。

normal.en: Compare reunion with reunification: the second is used for whole countries or organisations.
normal.cn: 对比 reunification：后者多用于国家或组织的统一。

abstract.en: Picture two halves of a broken plate clicking perfectly together again.
abstract.cn: 想象碎成两半的盘子「咔」地一声又严丝合缝拼回一起。

abstract.en: Imagine a photo split by scissors being taped along the cut line.
abstract.cn: 想象被剪刀分开的照片，沿着裂口重新贴好。

abstract.en: Think of a long-lost dog running straight back into a child open arms.
abstract.cn: 想象走失很久的狗一下扑回孩子张开的怀抱。

examples.en: The yearly reunion brings the whole village back for one long meal.
examples.cn: 一年一度的团聚让整个村子的人都回来吃一顿长长的饭。

examples.en: Their reunion after the war was brief but never forgotten.
examples.cn: 战后的那次重逢很短暂，却令人永远难忘。

examples.en: Organisers expect two hundred former pupils at the reunion.
examples.cn: 组织者预计会有两百名校友参加这次同学会。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞尤尼恩」——读起来像「又由你」把大家凑到一起，那就是团聚；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（再一次）+ unus / unio（一；联合）→ 法语 reunion → 英语 reunion，核心义「把分开的重新合成一个」。同根词有 unite、union、unit、unique。

sensesIntro.en: Reunion moves from a real meeting of separated people, to a planned event, to the joining of parts, to the healing of estrangement.
sensesIntro.cn: reunion 从分离之人的真实相聚，走向有组织的活动，再到部件重新合一，最后落到隔阂的消解。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two magnets that had been apart snapping back together.
core.cn: 核心意象：两块分开的磁铁「啪」地又吸回原处。

branches.en: People meeting face to face after a separation.
branches.cn: 分离之后面对面地再次相见。

branches.en: The same meeting, now scheduled and organised.
branches.cn: 同样的相见，被排上日程、有了组织。

branches.en: Parts or groups that become one whole again.
branches.cn: 部分或团体重新合为一个整体。

branches.en: Emotional distance closed between two people.
branches.cn: 两个人之间情感距离的缩小。

branches.en: Most reunions are a single meeting turned into a yearly ritual.
branches.cn: 许多团聚都由一次见面渐渐变成年年举行的仪式。

intro.en: Reunion is a two-piece word: the prefix re- and the Latin one-root un-, with a family of unite, union, unit, and unique.
intro.cn: reunion 由两部分构成：前缀 re- 与拉丁语「一」词根 un-，同族还有 unite、union、unit、unique。

latinIntro.en: Unus means one in Latin, and every word in this family is about making or being one.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 unus 意为「一」，这一词族的每个词都与「合为一」或「是一」有关。

items.example: The prefix re- marks a second doing.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 标记「第二次做」。

items.example: The root un- carries the meaning of one.
items.exampleCN: 词根 un- 承载「一」的意思。

items.example: The two clubs united under one name.
items.exampleCN: 两个俱乐部合并成了一个名字。

items.example: The suffix -ion forms union and reunion.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ion 构成 union 与 reunion。

items.example: The trade union speaks for its members.
items.exampleCN: 工会为其成员发声。

items.example: Each unit of the course takes a week.
items.exampleCN: 课程的每个单元耗时一周。

items.example: Her style is unique.
items.exampleCN: 她的风格独一无二。

items.example: The charity reunited the family after the flood.

items.example: The suffix -ify forms reunify.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ify 构成 reunify。

items.meaning: to bring divided parts into one country again
items.example: The plan was to reunify the two regions.
items.exampleCN: 计划是把两个地区重新统一起来。

latinEntries.meaning: a unit, oneness; a kind of pearl
latinEntries.meaningCN: 单一；统一；亦指一颗珍珠

definition_zh: 使重聚；重新结合；重新统一
definition_en: to bring people or things together again after they have been apart
core_image: 散落的线头被重新捻回同一根绳子里
scene: 洪水退去后的第三天，志愿者终于把走散的孩子领回了父母身边。The volunteers managed to reunite the girl with her parents after three days apart.
sceneCN: 这里 reunite 是「使重聚」（第 1 个义项：把分开的人重新聚到一起）；句意：分开三天后，志愿者成功让女孩与父母重新相聚。

pos.zh: 使重聚；使重新结合；使重新统一
重聚；再联合

senses.title: To bring separated people back together
senses.titleCN: 使重聚；让分离的人重逢
senses.definition: to cause people who have been apart to meet again
senses.definitionCN: 使分开的人再次见面
senses.example: The charity reunites refugee families across the border.
senses.exampleCN: 这家慈善机构让越过边境的难民家庭重聚。
senses.why: The prefix re- means again and unite means to join, so reunite is simply to join again.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 re- 表示「再一次」，unite 表示「结合」，因此 reunite 就是把它们重新结合。

senses.title: To join parts or pieces again
senses.definition: to put separated parts of a thing back into one whole
senses.definitionCN: 把事物的各个部分重新拼成一个整体
senses.example: Engineers reunited the warped panels with the framework.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师把变形的水泥板重新接到了框架上。
senses.why: Since unite also works for objects, reunite can describe planks, wires, or documents brought back into contact.
senses.whyCN: unite 也能用于物体，所以 reunite 可指木板、电线或文件重新接合。

senses.title: To bring regions or groups back under one whole
senses.definition: to bring divided territories, organisations, or parties into a single unit again
senses.definitionCN: 把分裂的领土、组织或派别重新归入一个整体
senses.example: The treaty pledged to reunite the two regions within one state.
senses.exampleCN: 条约承诺在一个国家内重新统一这两个地区。
senses.why: The Latin unio means one, so the political sense is a promise of oneness regained.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 unio 意为「一」，所以政治义就是许诺「一体」的失而复得。

senses.title: To meet up again oneself
senses.definition: of people, to come together again in the same place
senses.definitionCN: 指人们又在同一处相聚
senses.example: The band reunited for a single charity concert.
senses.exampleCN: 乐队为一场慈善音乐会重新聚首。
senses.why: The verb is often intransitive, so the same word can describe the people rather than whoever brought them together.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词常用作不及物，因此同一词也能描述相聚的人，而不只是促成相聚的人。

intro.en: Reunite is the Latin prefix re- on unite, whose root is unus, one; it reached English from French and was long rare before the nineteenth century.
intro.cn: reunite 是拉丁语前缀 re- 加到 unite 上，词根是 unus（一）；经法语进入英语，在十九世纪之前一直很罕见。

items.en: Unus means one, and unus gives inire and unire, to make one.
items.cn: unus 意为「一」，而 unire 意为使合而为一。

items.en: French reunir joins re- to unir.
items.cn: 法语 reunir 把 re- 加到 unir 上。

items.en: Medieval and later Latin reunit is used chiefly in learned and legal contexts.
items.cn: 中世纪及以后的拉丁语 reunit 主要用于学术与法律场合。

items.en: Reunite enters English as a rare learned verb.
items.cn: reunite 作为罕见的学术动词进入英语。

items.en: The verb grows common with news of families and nations brought together again.
items.cn: 随着家庭与国家重聚的新闻传播，这个动词渐渐常见。

items.en: Modern English uses reunite for refugees, bands, and divided territories alike.
items.cn: 现代英语用它同时描述难民、乐队与分裂的领土。

note.en: Reunite stands in the Latin one-family of unite and union, and it borders on reconcile and bring together in meaning.
note.cn: reunite 属于 unite、union 这一拉丁语「一」词族，意义上与 reconcile、bring together 相邻。

entries.definition: the act or event of coming together again
entries.definitionCN: 重逢；聚会；由 reunite 加名词词尾构成

entries.definition: to join two or more things as one
entries.definitionCN: 联合；团结，是本词去掉 re- 的基础动词

entries.definition: joined together in agreement
entries.definitionCN: 联合的；团结的，是 unite 的分词形

entries.definition: to return good or bad to someone in kind
entries.definitionCN: 报答；报复，只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: to restore friendly relations after a conflict
entries.definitionCN: 和解；使恢复友好，侧重矛盾而非分离

entries.definition: to gather people or forces together again into a group
entries.definitionCN: 重新集结；重新编组，常用于军队或团体

entries.definition: to gather pieces or people together into one place
entries.definitionCN: 集合；装配，不含「曾经在一起」的前提

normalIntro.en: Reunite is unite with re- in front: join them, then join them once more.
normalIntro.cn: reunite 就是 unite 前面加 re-：先联合，再联合一次。

normal.en: Unite comes from Latin unus, one.
normal.cn: unite 来自拉丁语 unus，意为「一」。

normal.en: The prefix re- marks a repeated action, so reunite is a second uniting.
normal.cn: 前缀 re- 标记重复的动作，因此 reunite 是第二次 unite。

normal.en: Be reunited with is the fixed passive used by news reports.
normal.cn: be reunited with 是新闻里固定的被动搭配。

normal.en: The noun reunion simply drops the e of the verb.
normal.cn: 名词 reunion 只是把动词词尾的 e 去掉。

normal.en: Compare unify: it makes different things one, reunite makes one thing whole again.
normal.cn: 对比 unify：前者把不同之物变为一，reunite 则让一物重归完整。

abstract.en: Picture two children holding hands again after being lost in a crowd.
abstract.cn: 想象在人群里走散的两个孩子又牵起了手。

abstract.en: Imagine scattered thread strands being twisted back into one rope.
abstract.cn: 想象散开的线缕被重新捻回同一根绳子。

abstract.en: Think of two nations laying down a wall and shaking hands across it.
abstract.cn: 想象两个国家拆掉界墙，隔着原址握手。

examples.en: Staff worked through the night to reunite lost children with their parents.
examples.cn: 工作人员通宵工作，让走失的孩子与父母重聚。

examples.en: The choir will reunite for the anniversary concert next spring.
examples.cn: 合唱团将于明年春天为周年音乐会重新聚首。

examples.en: A treaty reunified the country only when both sides agreed.
examples.cn: 只有在双方同意之后，条约才使国家重新统一。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞优耐特」——「优」才「耐」得住分开，「特」别想重聚；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（再一次）+ unus（一）→ unire（使合为一）→ 法语 reunir → 英语 reunite，核心义「让分开的再合为一」。同根词有 union、unit、unique、unanimous。

sensesIntro.en: Reunite begins with people meeting again, extends to parts being rejoined, to territories made one, and finally to the intransitive meeting itself.
sensesIntro.cn: reunite 先从人的重逢说起，扩展到部件重新接合、领土合而为一，最后回到不及物的「相聚」本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: loose thread ends twisted back into a single rope.
core.cn: 核心意象：散开的线头被重新捻回同一根绳子。

branches.en: People are brought back into one another presence.
branches.cn: 人被重新带到彼此面前。

branches.en: Physical parts are rejoined into a whole.
branches.cn: 实体的部件被重新接回整体。

branches.en: Territories and organisations become one unit again.
branches.cn: 领土与组织重新成为一个单位。

branches.en: The intransitive side: people simply gather again.
branches.cn: 不及物一面：人自己又聚在一起。

branches.en: A reunion can be told from the helper side or from the people side.
branches.cn: 同一场重聚，可从促成者的角度讲，也可从相聚者的角度讲。

intro.en: Reunite is a prefix plus a verb: re- on unite, whose root un- means one, with relatives such as union, unit, and unique.
intro.cn: reunite 是前缀加动词：re- 接在 unite 上，词根 un- 意为「一」，亲属词有 union、unit、unique。

latinIntro.en: Latin unus is one, unire is to make one, and re- repeats the act.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 unus 是「一」，unire 是「使成为一」，而 re- 把这个动作重来一遍。

items.example: The prefix re- repeats the action.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 让动作重复。

items.example: The root un- is one in Latin.
items.exampleCN: 词根 un- 在拉丁语中意为「一」。

items.example: The villagers united to rebuild the bridge.
items.exampleCN: 村民合力重建了那座桥。

items.example: They reunited at the station.
items.exampleCN: 他们在车站重聚。

items.example: The suffix -ed forms reunited.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ed 构成 reunited。

items.example: The suffix -ion forms reunion.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ion 构成 reunion。

items.example: The team found unity after the loss.
items.exampleCN: 失利之后，队伍反而团结起来了。

items.meaning: the only one of its kind
items.example: Each fingerprint is unique.
items.exampleCN: 每一枚指纹都独一无二。

items.example: The suffix -fy forms reunify.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -fy 构成 reunify。

items.meaningCN: 意见一致的；全体一致的
items.example: The vote was unanimous.
items.exampleCN: 表决结果全体一致。

definition_zh: 再利用；重复使用；再次利用
definition_en: to use something again, either for the same purpose or for a new one
core_image: 空玻璃瓶被洗净后重新灌满，摆回原来的货架
scene: 实验室把用过的玻璃瓶洗净消毒，再次装试剂。The lab washes and sterilises spent glass bottles so it can reuse them for other reagents.
sceneCN: 这里 reuse 是「重复使用」（第 1 个义项：把同一件东西再用一次）；句意：实验室把用过的玻璃瓶洗净，再次用来装其他试剂。

pos.zh: 再利用；重复使用；再次利用
再利用；重复使用

derivatives.zh: 可重复使用的；可再利用的
可复用性
重复使用某物的人（较少用）

senses.title: To use something again
senses.definition: to use a thing once more instead of throwing it away
senses.definitionCN: 把一件东西再用一次，而不是把它丢弃
senses.example: She reuses the same glass jar for storing rice.
senses.exampleCN: 她用同一个玻璃罐反复装米。
senses.why: The prefix re- returns the action to the starting point, so the verb simply sends an object back into use.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 re- 把动作送回到起点，因此这个动词只是让物件重新进入使用状态。

senses.title: To apply something to a new purpose
senses.definition: to use an object or material for a different purpose than the first one
senses.definitionCN: 把某物或某种材料用在不同于原先的用途上
senses.example: Old tyres are reused as playground surfacing.
senses.exampleCN: 旧轮胎被改用作游乐场地面材料。
senses.why: The word does not require the same job, so the object may leave its first role and start a second life.
senses.whyCN: 这个词并不要求用途相同，所以物件可以脱离原角色，开始第二段生命。

senses.title: To process and return to use
senses.definition: to treat waste or used material so that it can be used again
senses.definitionCN: 对废弃物或旧材料加以处理，使其能够重新使用
senses.example: Treated sewage water is reused for irrigation.
senses.exampleCN: 处理过的污水被回收用于灌溉。
senses.why: In technical writing the verb covers industrial processing: waste is cleaned or reconstituted before it is put back into circulation.
senses.whyCN: 在技术性文本中，该动词指工业加工：废弃物先经清洁或重新塑形，才回到流通环节。

senses.title: The act of using again
senses.definition: the act or practice of using something again
senses.definitionCN: 再次使用某物的行为或做法
senses.example: Reuse of bottles cuts landfill waste in the city.
senses.exampleCN: 瓶子的再利用减少了城市的填埋垃圾。
senses.why: English words of this type often turn into nouns without change, so the action itself can be named.
senses.whyCN: 这类英语动词常不加词尾就转为名词，因此这一行为本身也可以被命名。

intro.en: Reuse is a transparent modern compound of the Latin-derived prefix re- and the native verb use.
intro.cn: reuse 是透明的现代复合词，由源自拉丁语的前缀 re- 与本族动词 use 构成。

items.en: The prefix re- means back or again.
items.cn: 前缀 re- 意为向后、再次。

items.en: The verb user means to make use of something.
items.cn: 古法语动词 user 意为使用某物。

items.en: Use enters Middle English from Old French.
items.cn: use 在中古英语时期由古法语进入英语。

items.en: Reuse appears as a practical compound in technical and industrial writing.
items.cn: reuse 作为实用复合词出现在技术与工业文献中。

items.en: Modern usage pairs reuse with recycle in public language about waste.
items.cn: 现代用法把 reuse 与 recycle 一起用于公共话题中的废物处理。

items.en: Environmental policy makes the verb a keyword of waste management.
items.cn: 环境政策使这个动词成为废物管理的关键词。

note.en: Group one holds words built with the same re- prefix; group two holds the other members of the waste-handling vocabulary.
note.cn: 第一组是同带 re- 前缀的词；第二组是废物处理话题中的其他词。

entries.definition: The everyday verb that reuse extends.
entries.definitionCN: reuse 所扩展的日常动词。

entries.definition: To process waste into new products rather than using the same item again.
entries.definitionCN: 把废物加工成新产品，而不是把同一件东西再用一次。

entries.definition: To produce a new version of a text.
entries.definitionCN: 写出某文本的新版本。

entries.definition: To fill a container again, especially a drink or a pen.
entries.definitionCN: 把容器重新装满；只是拼写相近，词源不同。

entries.definition: To convert waste into reusable material.
entries.definitionCN: 把废物转化为可再利用的材料。

entries.definition: To give an object a new function.
entries.definitionCN: 给物件赋予新用途。

entries.definition: To protect resources by using them carefully.
entries.definitionCN: 节约使用以保护资源。

normalIntro.en: Think re- as again plus use as to make use of: the same object goes back into service.
normalIntro.cn: 把 re- 理解为「再次」，把 use 理解为「使用」：同一件东西重新投入使用。

normal.en: The prefix re- adds the idea of a second turn.
normal.cn: 前缀 re- 加上了「第二次」的含义。

normal.en: Reuse can share an object but keep the price of new goods down.
normal.cn: 重复使用可让别人共享同一物件，也压低购买新品的开销。

normal.en: Pair it with recycle: reuse keeps the item, recycle breaks it down.
normal.cn: 和 recycle 搭配记：reuse 保留物件，recycle 打碎再造。

normal.en: The adjective reusable is formed with the suffix -able.
normal.cn: 形容词 reusable 由词尾 -able 构成。

normal.en: Public campaigns say refuse, reduce, reuse, recycle.
normal.cn: 公共宣传常说「拒绝、减少、再利用、回收」四步。

abstract.en: Picture a glass bottle washed and refilled, not smashed.
abstract.cn: 想象一只玻璃瓶被洗净灌满，而不是被砸碎。

abstract.en: Imagine a tyre leaving the car and becoming soft ground under swings.
abstract.cn: 想象一只轮胎离开汽车，变成秋千下的软地面。

abstract.en: Think of dirty water passing through a filter and returning to the fields.
abstract.cn: 想想脏水穿过过滤器，又回到田野里。

examples.en: Many families reuse shopping bags to cut down on plastic.
examples.cn: 许多家庭重复使用购物袋以减少塑料。

examples.en: The factory reuses waste heat to warm its offices.
examples.cn: 这家工厂回收余热来给办公室供暖。

examples.en: Reuse is cheaper than building a brand new plant.
examples.cn: 再利用比新建一座工厂更便宜。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞优斯」——用旧了还能「优」着再用一次，就是 reuse；这只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: re-（再次、回到）＋ use（使用，经古法语 user 来自拉丁语 uti）→ reuse，核心义「让旧物重新进入使用」。

sensesIntro.en: Reuse begins with the simple act of using a thing again, extends to new purposes and industrial treatment, and finally names the practice itself.
sensesIntro.cn: reuse 先从把一件东西再用一次这个简单动作出发，扩展到改用他途与工业处理，最后指这种做法本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bottle washed clean and filled again.
core.cn: 核心意象：洗净后重新装满的瓶子。

branches.en: Using the same thing twice is the plain everyday sense.
branches.cn: 把同一件东西用两次是最朴素的日常义项。

branches.en: A second life for an object grows out of the second turn of use.
branches.cn: 物件的第二段生命由「再一次使用」生长出来。

branches.en: Industrial treatment is the technical extension of the same idea.
branches.cn: 工业处理是同一想法的技术延伸。

branches.en: Naming the act turns the verb into a public policy term.
branches.cn: 给行为命名，使这个动词变成公共政策的用语。

branches.en: Both keep the object intact and defer its disposal.
branches.cn: 两者都让物件完整保留，推迟它被丢弃的时间。

intro.en: Reuse joins the Latin prefix re- to the Old French verb user, and the family spreads through -able endings.
intro.cn: reuse 把拉丁语前缀 re- 与古法语动词 user 拼在一起，词族经 -able 词尾扩展。

latinIntro.en: Latin uti means to use, and its frequentative usare gave French user and English use.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 uti 意为使用，其反复形式 usare 衍生出法语 user 与英语 use。

items.example: Re- points the action back to its start.
items.exampleCN: re- 把动作指回起点。

items.example: Use is the stem of reuse.
items.exampleCN: use 是 reuse 的词干。

items.example: The suffix -able makes reusable.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -able 构成 reusable。

items.example: The ending gives reusability.
items.exampleCN: 该词尾构成 reusability。

items.example: The -er agent forms reuser.
items.exampleCN: 施事词尾 -er 构成 reuser。

items.example: The participle often serves as an adjective.
items.exampleCN: 过去分词常作形容词。

items.example: The gerund appears after prepositions.
items.exampleCN: 动名词出现在介词之后。

items.example: Useful shows the same stem with -ful.
items.exampleCN: useful 展示同一词干加 -ful。

items.example: Misuse places the stem after mis-.
items.exampleCN: misuse 把词干放在 mis- 之后。
